εἷς heîs, hice; a primary numeral; one:—a(-n, -ny,
 certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See
 also G1527, G3367, G3391, G3762.

G1521.definition:
εἰσάγω eiságō, ice-ag'-o; from G1519 and G71; to introduce (literally or figuratively):—bring
 in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.

G1522.definition: εἰσακούω eisakoúō, ice-ak-oo'-o; from G1519 and G191; to listen to:—hear.

G1523.definition: εἰσδέχομαι eisdéchomai, ice-dekh'-om-ahee; from G1519 and G1209; to take into one's favor:—receive.

G1524.definition: εἴσειμι eíseimi, ice'-i-mee; from G1519 and εἶμι eîmi (to go); to enter:—enter (go) into.

G1525.definition:
εἰσέρχομαι eisérchomai, ice-er'-khom-ahee; from G1519 and G2064; to enter (literally or figuratively):—X arise,
 come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).

G1526.definition:
εἰσί eisí, i-see'; 3rd person plural present indicative of G1510; they are:—agree, are,
 be, dure, × is, were.

G1528.definition: εἰσκαλέω eiskaléō, ice-kal-eh'-o; from G1519 and G2564; to invite in:—call in.

G1529.definition:
εἴσοδος eísodos, ice'-od-os; from G1519 and G3598; an entrance (literally or figuratively):—coming,
 enter(-ing) in (to).

G153.definition:
αἰσχύνομαι aischýnomai, ahee-skhoo'-nom-ahee; from αἶσχος aîschos (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for
 oneself):—be ashamed.

G1530.definition: †εἰσπηδάω eispēdáō, ice-pay-dah'-o; from G1519 and πηδάω pēdáō (to leap); to rush in:—run (spring) in.

G1531.definition:
εἰσπορεύομαι eisporeúomai, ice-por-yoo'-om-ahee; from G1519 and G4198; to enter (literally or figuratively):—come
 (enter) in, go into.

G1532.definition: εἰστρέχω eistréchō, ice-trekh'-o; from G1519 and G5143; to hasten inward:—run in.

G1533.definition:
εἰσφέρω eisphérō, ice-fer'-o; from G1519 and G5342; to carry inward (literally or
 figuratively):—bring (in), lead into.

G1534.definition:
†εἶτα eîta, i'-tah; of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical
 enumeration), then, moreover:—after that(-ward), furthermore, then. 
 See also G1899.

G1535.definition: εἴτε eíte, i'-teh; from G1487 and G5037; if too:—if, or, whether.

G1536.definition:
†εἴ τις eí tis, i tis; from G1487 and G5100; if any:—he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from
 any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

G1537.definition:
ἐκ ek, ek; a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or
 motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or
 figurative; direct or remote):—after, among, × are, at,
 betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above),
 for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X
 heavenly, × hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of,
 off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, × thenceforth,
 through,
 × unto, × vehemently, with(-out).

G1538.definition:
ἕκαστος hékastos, hek'-as-tos; as if a superlative of ἕκας hékas (afar); each or every:—any, both, each
 (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

G1539.definition: ἑκάστοτε hekástote, hek-as'-tot-eh; as if from G1538 and G5119; at every time:—always.

G154.definition:
αἰτέω aitéō, ahee-teh'-o; of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case):—ask, beg, call
 for, crave, desire, require. Compare G4441.

G1540.definition: ἑκατόν hekatón, hek-at-on'; of uncertain affinity; a hundred:—hundred.

G1541.definition: †ἑκατονταέτης hekatontaétēs, hek-at-on-tah-et'-ace; from G1540 and G2094; centenarian:—hundred years old.

G1542.definition:
ἑκατονταπλασίων hekatontaplasíōn, hek-at-on-ta-plah-sec'-own; from G1540 and a presumed derivative of G4111; a hundred
 times:—hundredfold.

G1543.definition: ἑκατοντάρχης hekatontárchēs, hek-at-on-tar'-khace; from G1540 and G757; the captain of one hundred men:—centurion.

G1544.definition:
ἐκβάλλω ekbállō, ek-bal'-lo; from G1537 and G906; to eject (literally or figuratively):—bring forth,
 cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take,
 thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

G1545.definition:
†ἔκβασις ékbasis, ek'-bas-is; from a compound of G1537 and the base of G939 (meaning to go out); an
 exit (literally or figuratively):—end, way to escape.

G1546.definition:
ἐκβολή ekbolḗ, ek-bol-ay'; from G1544; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the
 cargo:—+ lighten the ship.

G1549.definition:
†ἔκγονον ékgonon, ek'-gon-on; neuter of a derivative of a compound of G1537 and G1096; a descendant,
 i.e. (specially) grandchild:—nephew.

G155.definition:
αἴτημα aítēma, ah'-ee-tay-mah; from G154; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking:—petition, request,
 required.

G1550.definition:
ἐκδαπανάω ekdapanáō, ek-dap-an-ah'-o; from G1537 and G1159; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively)
 exhaust:—spend.

G1551.definition:
ἐκδέχομαι ekdéchomai, ek-dekh'-om-ahee; from G1537 and G1209; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication)
 to await:—expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

G1552.definition: ἔκδηλος ékdēlos, ek'-day-los; from G1537 and G1212; wholly evident:—manifest.

G1553.definition:
ἐκδημέω ekdēméō, ek-day-meh'-o; from a compound of G1537 and G1218; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively)
 vacate or quit:—be absent.

G1554.definition:
ἐκδίδωμι ekdídōmi, ek-did-o'-mee; from G1537 and G1325; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:—let
 forth (out).

G1555.definition:
ἐκδιηγέομαι ekdiēgéomai, ek-dee-ayg-eh'-om-ahee; from G1537 and a compound of G1223 and G2233; to narrate through
 wholly:—declare.

G1556.definition: ἐκδικέω ekdikéō, ek-dik-eh'-o; from G1558; to vindicate, retaliate, punish:—a (re-)venge.

G1557.definition:
ἐκδίκησις ekdíkēsis, ek-dik'-ay-sis; from G1556; vindication, retribution:—(a-, re-)venge(-ance),
 punishment.

G1558.definition:
ἔκδικος ékdikos, ek'-dik-os; from G1537 and G1349; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:—a
 (re-)venger.

G1559.definition:
ἐκδιώκω ekdiṓkō, ek-dee-o'-ko; from G1537 and G1377; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute
 implacably:—persecute.

G156.definition:
αἰτία aitía, ahee-tee'-a; from the same as G154; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason
 (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):—accusation,
 case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

G1560.definition:
ἔκδοτος ékdotos, ek'-dot-os; from G1537 and a derivative of G1325; given out or over, i.e.
 surrendered:—delivered.

G1561.definition: ἐκδοχή ekdochḗ, ek-dokh-ay'; from G1551; expectation:—looking for.

G1562.definition:
ἐκδύω ekdýō, ek-doo'-o; from G1537 and the base of G1416; to cause to sink out of, i.e.
 (specially as of clothing) to divest:—strip, take off from, unclothe.

G1563.definition:
ἐκεῖ ekeî, ek-i'; of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:—there,
 thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).

G1564.definition: ἐκεῖθεν ekeîthen, ek-i'-then; from G1563; thence:—from that place, (from) thence, there.

G1565.definition:
ἐκεῖνος ekeînos, ek-i'-nos; from G1563; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the
 article prefixed:—he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same,
 very), × their, × them, they, this, those. See also G3778.

G1566.definition: ἐκεῖσε ekeîse, ek-i'-seh; from G1563; thither:—there.

G1567.definition:
ἐκζητέω ekzētéō, ek-zay-teh'-o; from G1537 and G2212; to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate,
 crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship:—en- (re-)quire, seek after
 (carefully, diligently).

G1568.definition: ἐκθαμβέω ekthambéō, ek-tham-beh'-o; from G1569; to astonish utterly:—affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

G1569.definition: ἔκθαμβος ékthambos, ek'-tham-bos; from G1537 and G2285; utterly astounded:—greatly wondering.

G1570.definition:
ἔκθετος ékthetos, ek'-thet-os; from G1537 and a derivative of G5087; put out, i.e. exposed to
 perish:—cast out.

G1571.definition: ἐκκαθαίρω ekkathaírō, ek-kath-ah'-ee-ro; from G1537 and G2508; to cleanse thoroughly:—purge (out).

G1572.definition: ἐκκαίω ekkaíō, ek-kah'-yo; from G1537 and G2545; to inflame deeply:—burn.

G1574.definition: ἐκκεντέω ekkentéō, ek-ken-teh'-o; from G1537 and the base of G2759; to transfix:—pierce.

G1575.definition: ἐκκλάω ekkláō, ek-klah'-o; from G1537 and G2806; to exscind:—break off.

G1576.definition: ἐκκλείω ekkleíō, ek-kli'-o; from G1537 and G2808; to shut out (literally or figuratively):—exclude.

G1577.definition:
ἐκκλησία ekklēsía, ek-klay-see'-ah; from a compound of G1537 and a derivative of G2564; a calling out, i.e.
 (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation
 (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or
 saints in heaven or both):—assembly, church.

G1578.definition:
ἐκκλίνω ekklínō, ek-klee'-no; from G1537 and G2827; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally
 or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):—avoid,
 eschew, go out of the way.

G1579.definition: ἐκκολυμβάω ekkolymbáō, ek-kol-oom-bah'-o; from G1537 and G2860; to escape by swimming:—swim out.

G1580.definition: ἐκκομίζω ekkomízō, ek-kom-id'-zo; from G1537 and G2865; to bear forth (to burial):—carry out.

G1581.definition:
ἐκκόπτω ekkóptō, ek-kop'-to; from G1537 and G2875; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:—cut down
 (off, out), hew down, hinder.

G1582.definition:
†ἐκκρέμαμαι ekkrémamai, ek-krem'-am-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G2910; to hang upon the lips of a speaker,
 i.e. listen closely:—be very attentive.

G1583.definition: ἐκλαλέω eklaléō, ek-lal-eh'-o; from G1537 and G2980; to divulge:—tell.

G1584.definition: ἐκλάμπω eklámpō, ek-lam'-po; from G1537 and G2989; to be resplendent:—shine forth.

G1585.definition: †ἐκλανθάνομαι eklanthánomai, ek-lan-than'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G2990; to be utterly oblivious of:—forget.

G1586.definition:
†ἐκλέγομαι eklégomai, ek-leg'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G3004 (in its primary sense); to
 select:—make choice, choose (out), chosen.

G1587.definition: ἐκλείπω ekleípō, ek-li'-po; from G1537 and G3007; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):—fail.

G1588.definition: ἐκλεκτός eklektós, ek-lek-tos'; from G1586; select; by implication, favorite:—chosen, elect.

G1589.definition:
ἐκλογή eklogḗ, ek-log-ay'; from G1586; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely):—chosen,
 election.

G159.definition: αἴτιος aítios, ah'-ee-tee-os; from the same as G154; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer:—author.

G1590.definition: ἐκλύω eklýō, ek-loo'-o; from G1537 and G3089; to relax (literally or figuratively):—faint.

G1591.definition:
ἐκμάσσω ekmássō, ek-mas'-so; from G1537 and the base of G3145; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to
 wipe dry:—wipe.

G1592.definition: †ἐκμυκτηρίζω ekmyktērízō, ek-mook-ter-id'-zo; from G1537 and G3456; to sneer outright at:—deride.

G1593.definition:
ἐκνεύω ekneúō, ek-nyoo'-o; from G1537 and G3506; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly
 withdraw:—convey self away.

G1594.definition:
ἐκνήφω eknḗphō, ek-nay'-fo; from G1537 and G3525; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of
 stupor:—awake.

G1595.definition: †ἑκούσιον hekoúsion, hek-oo'-see-on; neuter of a derivative from G1635; voluntariness:—willingly.

G1596.definition: ἑκουσίως hekousíōs, hek-oo-see'-ose; adverb from the same as G1595; voluntarily:—wilfully, willingly.

G1597.definition:
ἔκπαλαι ékpalai, eh'-pal-ahee; from G1537 and G3819; long ago, for a long while:—of a long time, of
 old.

G1598.definition: ἐκπειράζω ekpeirázō, ek-pi-rad'-zo; from G1537 and G3985; to test thoroughly:—tempt.

G1599.definition: ἐκπέμπω ekpémpō, ek-pem'-po; from G1537 and G3992; to despatch:—send away (forth).

G16.definition: ἀγαθοποιΐα agathopoiḯa, ag-ath-op-oy-ee'-ah; from G17; well-doing, i.e. virtue:—well-doing.

G160.definition:
αἰφνίδιος aiphnídios, aheef-nid'-ee-os; from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316 (compare G1810)
 (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially)
 suddenly:—sudden, unawares.

G1600.definition:
ἐκπετάννυμι ekpetánnymi, ek-pet-an'-noo-mee; from G1537 and a form of G4072; to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to
 extend:—stretch forth.

G1601.definition:
ἐκπίπτω ekpíptō, ek-pip'-to; from G1537 and G4098; to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's
 course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient:—be cast, fail,
 fall (away, off), take none effect.

G1602.definition: ἐκπλέω ekpléō, ek-pleh'-o; from G1537 and G4126; to depart by ship:—sail (away, thence).

G1603.definition: ἐκπληρόω ekplēróō, ek-play-ro'-o; from G1537 and G4137; to accomplish entirely:—fulfill.

G1604.definition: ἐκπλήρωσις ekplḗrōsis, ek-play'-ro-sis; from G1603; completion:—accomplishment.

G1605.definition: †ἐκπλήσσω ekplḗssō, ek-place'-so; from G1537 and G4141; to strike with astonishment:—amaze, astonish.

G1606.definition: ἐκπνέω ekpnéō, ek-pneh'-o; from G1537 and G4154; to expire:—give up the ghost.

G1607.definition:
ἐκπορεύομαι ekporeúomai, ek-por-yoo'-om-ahee; from G1537 and G4198; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:—come
 (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

G1608.definition:
ἐκπορνεύω ekporneúō, ek-porn-yoo'-o; from G1537 and G4203; to be utterly unchaste:—give self over to
 fornication.

G1609.definition: ἐκπτύω ekptýō, ek-ptoo'-o; from G1537 and G4429; to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn:—reject.

G161.definition: αἰχμαλωσία aichmalōsía, aheekh-mal-o-see'-ah; from G164; captivity:—captivity.

G1610.definition: ἐκριζόω ekrizóō, ek-rid-zo'-o; from G1537 and G4492; to uproot:—pluck up by the root, root up.

G1611.definition:
ἔκστασις ékstasis, ek'-stas-is; from G1839; a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment,
 "ecstasy":—+ be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

G1612.definition: ἐκστρέφω ekstréphō, ek-stref'-o; from G1537 and G4762; to pervert (figuratively):—subvert.

G1613.definition: ἐκταράσσω ektarássō, ek-tar-as'-so; from G1537 and G5015; to disturb wholly:—exceedingly trouble.

G1614.definition:
ἐκτείνω ekteínō, ek-ti'-no; from G1537 and teino (to stretch); to extend:—cast, put forth, stretch
 forth (out).

G1615.definition: ἐκτελέω ekteléō, ek-tel-eh'-o; from G1537 and G5055; to complete fully:—finish.

G1616.definition: ἐκτένεια ekténeia, ek-ten'-i-ah; from G1618; intentness:—X instantly.

G1618.definition: ἐκτενής ektenḗs, ek-ten-ace'; from G1614; intent:—without ceasing, fervent.

G1619.definition: ἐκτενῶς ektenōs, ek-ten-oce'; adverb from G1618; intently:—fervently.

G162.definition: αἰχμαλωτεύω aichmalōteúō, aheekh-mal-o-tew'-o; from G164; to capture (like G163):—lead captive.

G1620.definition:
ἐκτίθημι ektíthēmi, ek-tith'-ay-mee; from G1537 and G5087; to expose; figuratively, to declare:—cast out,
 expound.

G1621.definition: ἐκτινάσσω ektinássō, ek-tin-as'-so; from G1537 and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently:—shake (off).

G1622.definition:
ἐκτός ektós, ek-tos'; from G1537; the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from,
 besides:—but, except(-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless,
 without.

G1623.definition: ἕκτος héktos, hek'-tos; ordinal from G1803; sixth:—sixth.

G1624.definition:
ἐκτρέπω ektrépō, ek-trep'-o; from G1537 and the base of G5157; to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally
 or figuratively):—avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

G1625.definition:
ἐκτρέφω ektréphō, ek-tref'-o; from G1537 and G5142; to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to
 cherish or train:—bring up, nourish.

G1626.definition:
ἔκτρωμα éktrōma, ek'-tro-mah; from a comparative of G1537 and τιτρώσκω titrṓskō (to wound); a miscarriage
 (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth:—born out of due time.

G1627.definition:
ἐκφέρω ekphérō, ek-fer'-o; from G1537 and G5342; to bear out (literally or figuratively):—bear,
 bring forth, carry forth (out).

G1628.definition: ἐκφεύγω ekpheúgō, ek-fyoo'-go; from G1537 and G5343; to flee out:—escape, flee.

G1629.definition: ἐκφοβέω ekphobéō, ek-fob-eh'-o; from G1537 and G5399; to frighten utterly:—terrify.

G163.definition: αἰχμαλωτίζω aichmalōtízō, aheekh-mal-o-tid'-zo; from G164; to make captive:—lead away captive, bring into captivity.

G1630.definition:
ἔκφοβος ékphobos, ek'-fob-os; from G1537 and G5401; frightened out of one's wits:—sore afraid,
 exceedingly fear.

G1631.definition: ἐκφύω ekphýō, ek-foo'-o; from G1537 and G5453; to sprout up:—put forth.

G1632.definition:
†ἐκχέω ekchéō, ek-kheh'-o; from G1537 and χέω chéō (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively, to
 bestow:—gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth),
 spill.

G1633.definition: ἐκχωρέω ekchōréō, ek-kho-reh'-o; from G1537 and G5562; to depart:—depart out.

G1634.definition: ἐκψύχω ekpsýchō, ek-psoo'-kho; from G1537 and G5594; to expire:—give (yield) up the ghost.

G1635.definition: ἑκών hekṓn, hek-own'; of uncertain affinity; voluntary:—willingly.

G1636.definition:
ἐλαία elaía, el-ah'-yah; feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive
 (the tree or the fruit):—olive (berry, tree).

G1637.definition: ἔλαιον élaion, el'-ah-yon; neuter of the same as G1636; olive oil:—oil.

G1638.definition:
ἐλαιών elaiṓn, el-ah-yone'; from G1636; an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of
 Olives:—Olivet.

G1639.definition: Ἐλαμίτης Elamítēs, el-am-ee'-tace; of Hebrew origin (H5867); an Elamite or Persian:—Elamite.

G164.definition:
†αἰχμάλωτος aichmálōtos, aheekh-mal-o-tos'; from αἰχμή aichmḗ (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259; properly, a
 prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:—captive.

G1640.definition:
ἐλάσσων elássōn, el-as'-sone; comparative of the same as G1646; smaller (in size, quantity, age or
 quality):—less, under, worse, younger.

G1641.definition: ἐλαττονέω elattonéō, el-at-ton-eh-o; from G1640; to diminish, i.e. fall short:—have lack.

G1642.definition: ἐλαττόω elattóō, el-at-to'-o; from G1640; to lessen (in rank or influence):—decrease, make lower.

G1643.definition:
ἐλαύνω elaúnō, el-ow'-no; a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses
 as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind,
 oars or dæmonical power):—carry, drive, row.

G1644.definition: ἐλαφρία elaphría, el-af-ree'-ah; from G1645; levity (figuratively), i.e. fickleness:—lightness.

G1645.definition: ἐλαφρός elaphrós, el-af-ros'; probably akin to G1643 and the base of G1640; light, i.e. easy:—light.

G1646.definition:
ἐλάχιστος eláchistos, el-akh'-is-tos; superlative of ἔλαχυς élachys (short); used as equivalent to G3398; least (in
 size, amount, dignity, etc.):—least, very little (small), smallest.

G1648.definition: Ἐλεάζαρ Eleázar, el-eh-ad'-zar; of Hebrew origin (H499); Eleazar, an Israelite:—Eleazar.

G1649.definition: ἔλεγξις élenxis, el'-eng-xis; from G1651; refutation, i.e. reproof:—rebuke.

G165.definition:
αἰών aiṓn, ahee-ohn'; from the same as G104; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also
 past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic
 period (present or future):—age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more),
 (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end). 
 Compare G5550.

G1650.definition: †ἔλεγχος élenchos, el'-eng-khos; from G1651; proof, conviction:—evidence, reproof.

G1651.definition:
ἐλέγχω elénchō, el-eng'-kho; of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish:—convict, convince, tell
 a fault, rebuke, reprove.

G1652.definition: ἐλεεινός eleeinós, el-eh-i-nos'; from G1656; pitiable:—miserable.

G1653.definition:
†ἐλεέω eleéō, el-eh-eh'-o; from G1656; to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine
 grace):—have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy
 (on).

G1654.definition:
ἐλεημοσύνη eleēmosýnē, el-eh-ay-mos-oo'-nay; from G1656; compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor)
 beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction:—alms(-deeds).

G1655.definition: ἐλεήμων eleḗmōn, el-eh-ay'-mone; from G1653; compassionate (actively):—merciful.

G1656.definition:
ἔλεος éleos, el'-eh-os; of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially
 active):—(+ tender) mercy.

G1657.definition:
ἐλευθερία eleuthería, el-yoo-ther-ee'-ah; from G1658; freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or
 ceremonial):—liberty.

G1658.definition:
ἐλεύθερος eleútheros, el-yoo'-ther-os; probably from the alternate of G2064; unrestrained (to go at pleasure),
 i.e. (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or
 (genitive case) exempt (from obligation or liability):—free (man,
 woman), at liberty.

G1659.definition:
ἐλευθερόω eleutheróō, el-yoo-ther-o'-o; from G1658; to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral,
 ceremonial or mortal liability):—deliver, make free.

G166.definition:
αἰώνιος aiṓnios, ahee-o'-nee-os; from G165; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as
 well):—eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

G1660.definition: ἔλευσις éleusis, el'-yoo-sis; from the alternate of G2064; an advent:—coming.

G1661.definition:
ἐλεφάντινος elephántinos, el-ef-an'-tee-nos; from ἔλεφας élephas (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication)
 composed of ivory:—of ivory.

G1662.definition: †Ἐλιακείμ Eliakeím, el-ee-ak-ime'; of Hebrew origin (H471); Eliakim, an Israelite:—Eliakim.

G1663.definition: Ἐλιέζερ Eliézer, el-ee-ed'-zer; of Hebrew origin (H461); Eliezer, an Israelite:—Eliezer.

G1664.definition:
Ἐλιούδ Elioúd, el-ee-ood'; of Hebrew origin (H410 and H1935); God of majesty; Eliud, an
 Israelite:—Eliud.

G1665.definition: Ἐλισάβετ Elisábet, el-ee-sab'-et; of Hebrew origin (H472); Elisabet, an Israelitess:—Elisabeth.

G1666.definition: †Ἐλισσαῖος Elissaîos, el-is-sah'-yos; of Hebrew origin (H477); Elissæus, an Israelite:—Elissæus.

G1667.definition: ἑλίσσω helíssō, hel-is'-so; a form of G1507; to coil or wrap:—fold up.

G1668.definition: ἕλκος hélkos, hel'-kos; probably from G1670; an ulcer (as if drawn together):—sore.

G1669.definition:
ἑλκόω helkóō, hel-ko'-o; from G1668; to cause to ulcerate, i.e. (passively) be ulcerous:—full
 of sores.

G167.definition: ἀκαθαρσία akatharsía, ak-ath-ar-see'-ah; from G169; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:—uncleanness.

G1670.definition:
†ἑλκύω helkýō, hel-koo'-o; probably akin to G138; to drag (literally or
 figuratively):—draw. Compare G1667.

G1671.definition:
Ἑλλάς Hellás, hel-las'; of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of
 Europe:—Greece.

G1672.definition:
Ἕλλην Héllēn, hel'-lane; from G1671; a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a
 Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew:—Gentile, Greek.

G1673.definition: Ἑλληνικός Hellēnikós, hel-lay-nee-kos'; from G1672; Hellenic, i.e. Grecian (in language):—Greek.

G1674.definition: Ἑλληνίς Hellēnís, hel-lay-nis'; feminine of G1672; a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman:—Greek.

G1675.definition:
Ἑλληνιστής Hellēnistḗs, hel-lay-nis-tace'; from a derivative of G1672; a Hellenist or Greek-speaking
 Jew:—Grecian.

G1676.definition:
Ἑλληνιστί Hellēnistí, hel-lay-nis-tee'; adverb from the same as G1675; Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian
 language:—Greek.

G1677.definition:
†ἐλλογέω ellogéō, el-log-eh'-o; from G1722 and G3056 (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e.
 attribute:—impute, put on account.

G1678.definition: †Ἐλμωδάμ Elmōdám, el-mo-dam'; of Hebrew origin (perhaps for H486); Elmodam, an Israelite:—Elmodam.

G1679.definition: ἐλπίζω elpízō, el-pid'-zo; from G1680; to expect or confide:—(have, thing) hope(-d) (for), trust.

G1680.definition:
ἐλπίς elpís, el-pece'; from a primary ἔλπω élpō (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); 
 expectation (abstractly or concretely) or confidence:—faith, hope.

G1681.definition: Ἐλύμας Elýmas, el-oo'-mas; of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard:—Elymas.

G1682.definition: †ἐλοΐ eloḯ, el-o-ee'; of Chaldean origin (H426 with pronominal suffix) my God:—Eloi.

G1683.definition:
ἐμαυτοῦ emautoû, em-ow-too'; genitive case compound of G1700 and G846; of myself

 so likewise the dative case
    ἐμαυτῷ emautōi  em-ow-to',

 and accusative case
    ἐμαυτόν emautón  em-ow-ton'

:—me, mine own (self), myself.

G1684.definition:
ἐμβαίνω embaínō, em-ba'-hee-no; from G1722 and the base of G939; to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a
 vessel), reach (a pool):—come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into,
 step in, take ship.

G1685.definition:
ἐμβάλλω embállō, em-bal'-lo; from G1722 and G906; to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to
 (eternal punishment):—cast into.

G1686.definition:
ἐμβάπτω embáptō, em-bap'-to; from G1722 and G911; to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.)
 by contact with a fluid:—dip.

G1687.definition:
ἐμβατεύω embateúō, em-bat-yoo'-o; from G1722 and a presumed derivative of the base of G939; equivalent to
 G1684; to intrude on (figuratively):—intrude into.

G1688.definition:
ἐμβιβάζω embibázō, em-bib-ad'-zo; from G1722 and βιβάζω bibázō (to mount; causative of G1684); to place on, i.e.
 transfer (aboard a vessel):—put in.

G1689.definition:
ἐμβλέπω emblépō, em-blep'-o; from G1722 and G991; to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly,
 or (absolutely) to discern clearly:—behold, gaze up, look upon,
 (could) see.

G169.definition:
ἀκάθαρτος akáthartos, ak-ath'-ar-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2508
 (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially,
 (demonic)):—foul, unclean.

G1690.definition:
ἐμβριμάομαι embrimáomai, em-brim-ah'-om-ahee; from G1722 and βριμάομαι brimáomai (to snort with anger); to have indignation on,
 i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin,
 (specially) to sternly enjoin:—straitly charge, groan, murmur
 against.

G1692.definition: ἐμέω eméō, em-eh'-o; of uncertain affinity; to vomit:—(will) spue.

G1693.definition: ἐμμαίνομαι emmaínomai, em-mah'-ee-nom-ahee; from G1722 and G3105; to rave on, i.e. rage at:—be mad against.

G1694.definition:
Ἐμμανουήλ Emmanouḗl, em-man-oo-ale'; of Hebrew origin (H6005); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of
 Christ:—Emmanuel.

G1695.definition:
Ἐμμαούς Emmaoús, em-mah-ooce'; probably of Hebrew origin (compare H3222); Emmaus, a place in
 Palestine:—Emmaus.

G1696.definition:
ἐμμένω emménō, em-men'-o; from G1722 and G3306; to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively)
 persevere:—continue.

G1697.definition: †Ἐμμόρ Emmór, em-mor'; of Hebrew origin (H2544); Emmor (i.e. Chamor), a Canaanite:—Emmor.

G1698.definition: ἐμοί emoí, em-oy'; a prolonged form of G3427; to me:—I, me, mine, my.

G1699.definition:
ἐμός emós, em-os'; from the oblique cases of G1473 (G1698, G1700, G1691); my:—of me, mine
 (own), my.

G17.definition: ἀγαθοποιός agathopoiós, ag-ath-op-oy-os'; from G18 and G4160; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous:—them that do well.

G170.definition:
ἀκαιρέομαι akairéomai, ak-ahee-reh'-om-ahee; from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2540 (meaning
 unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a
 proper occasion:—lack opportunity.

G1700.definition: ἐμοῦ emoû, em-oo'; a prolonged form of G3449; of me:—me, mine, my.

G1702.definition: ἐμπαίζω empaízō, emp-aheed'-zo; from G1722 and G3815; to jeer at, i.e. deride:—mock.

G1703.definition:
ἐμπαίκτης empaíktēs, emp-aheek-tace'; from G1702; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:—mocker,
 scoffer.

G1704.definition:
ἐμπεριπατέω emperipatéō, em-per-ee-pat-eh'-o; from G1722 and G4043; to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to
 be occupied among persons:—walk in.

G1705.definition:
†ἐμπίπλημι empíplēmi, em-pip'-lay-mee; from G1722 and the base of G4118; to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication)
 to satisfy (literally or figuratively):—fill.

G1706.definition:
ἐμπίπτω empíptō, em-pip'-to; from G1722 and G4098; to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by,
 or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with:—fall among (into).

G1707.definition:
ἐμπλέκω emplékō, em-plek'-o; from G1722 and G4120; to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve
 with:—entangle (in, self with).

G1708.definition: ἐμπλοκή emplokḗ, em-plok-ay'; from G1707; elaborate braiding of the hair:—plaiting.

G1709.definition:
ἐμπνέω empnéō, emp-neh'-o; from G1722 and G4154; to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by
 (bent upon):—breathe.

G171.definition: ἀκαίρως akaírōs, ak-ah'-ee-roce; adverb from the same as G170; inopportunely:—out of season.

G1710.definition:
ἐμπορεύομαι emporeúomai, em-por-yoo'-om-ahee; from G1722 and G4198; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by
 implication) to trade:—buy and sell, make merchandise.

G1711.definition: ἐμπορία emporía, em-por-ee'-ah; feminine from G1713; traffic:—merchandise.

G1712.definition: ἐμπόριον empórion, em-por'-ee-on; neuter from G1713; a mart ("emporium"):—merchandise.

G1713.definition: ἔμπορος émporos, em'-por-os; from G1722 and the base of G4198; a (wholesale) tradesman:—merchant.

G1715.definition:
ἔμπροσθεν émprosthen, em'-pros-then; from G1722 and G4314; in front of (in place (literally or figuratively)
 or time):—against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

G1716.definition: ἐμπτύω emptýō, emp-too'-o; from G1722 and G4429; to spit at or on:—spit (upon).

G1717.definition: ἐμφανής emphanḗs, em-fan-ace'; from a compound of G1722 and G5316; apparent in self:—manifest, openly.

G1718.definition:
ἐμφανίζω emphanízō, em-fan-id'-zo; from G1717; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):—appear,
 declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

G1719.definition:
ἔμφοβος émphobos, em'-fob-os; from G1722 and G5401; in fear, i.e. alarmed:—affrighted, afraid,
 tremble.

G172.definition:
ἄκακος ákakos, ak'-ak-os; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2556; not bad, i.e. (objectively)
 innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting:—harmless, simple.

G1720.definition:
ἐμφυσάω emphysáō, em-foo-sah'-o; from G1722 and φυσάω physáō (to puff) (compare G5453); to blow at or
 on:—breathe on.

G1721.definition:
ἔμφυτος émphytos, em'-foo-tos; from G1722 and a derivative of G5453; implanted
 (figuratively):—engrafted.

G1722.definition:
ἐν en, en; a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or
 state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or
 constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between G1519
 and G1537); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:—about, after, against, +
 almost, × altogether, among, × as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+
 all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to,
 -wardly), × mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, × outwardly,
 one, × quickly,
 × shortly, (speedi-)ly, × that, × there(-in, -on),
 through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while,
 with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same
 import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate
 direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different)
 preposition.

G1723.definition:
ἐναγκαλίζομαι enankalízomai, en-ang-kal-id'-zom-ahee; from G1722 and a derivative of G43; to take in one's arms, i.e.
 embrace:—take up in arms.

G1724.definition: ἐνάλιος enálios, en-al'-ee-os; from G1722 and G251; in the sea, i.e. marine:—thing in the sea.

G1725.definition: ἔναντι énanti, en'-an-tee; from G1722 and G473; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:—before.

G1726.definition:
ἐναντίον enantíon, en-an-tee'-on; neuter of G1727; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:—before, in
 the presence of.

G1727.definition:
ἐναντίος enantíos, en-an-tee'-os; from G1725; opposite; figuratively, antagonistic:—(over) against,
 contrary.

G1728.definition: ἐνάρχομαι enárchomai, en-ar'-khom-ahee; from G1722 and G756; to commence on:—rule (by mistake for G757).

G1729.definition:
ἐνδεής endeḗs, en-deh-ace'; from a compound of G1722 and G1210 (in the sense of lacking); deficient
 in:—lacking.

G173.definition: ἄκανθα ákantha, ak'-an-thah; probably from the same as G188; a thorn:—thorn.

G1730.definition: ἔνδειγμα éndeigma, en'-dighe-mah; from G1731; an indication (concretely):—manifest token.

G1731.definition: ἐνδείκνυμι endeíknymi, en-dike'-noo-mee; from G1722 and G1166; to indicate (by word or act):—do, show (forth).

G1732.definition: ἔνδειξις éndeixis, en'-dike-sis; from G1731; indication (abstractly):—declare, evident token, proof.

G1733.definition: ἕνδεκα héndeka, hen'-dek-ah; from (the neuter of) G1520 and G1176; one and ten, i.e. eleven:—eleven.

G1734.definition: ἑνδέκατος hendékatos, hen-dek'-at-os; ordinal from G1733; eleventh:—eleventh.

G1736.definition:
ἐνδημέω endēméō, en-day-meh'-o; from a compound of G1722 and G1218; to be in one's own country, i.e.
 home (figuratively):—be at home (present).

G1737.definition:
ἐνδιδύσκω endidýskō, en-did-oos'-ko; a prolonged form of G1746; to invest (with a garment):—clothe in,
 wear.

G1738.definition: ἔνδικος éndikos, en'-dee-kos; from G1722 and G1349; in the right, i.e. equitable:—just.

G174.definition: ἀκάνθινος akánthinos, ak-an'-thee-nos; from G173; thorny:—of thorns.

G1740.definition: ἐνδοξάζω endoxázō, en-dox-ad'-zo; from G1741; to glorify:—glorify.

G1741.definition:
ἔνδοξος éndoxos, en'-dox-os; from G1722 and G1391; in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively)
 noble:—glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.

G1742.definition:
ἔνδυμα éndyma, en'-doo-mah; from G1746; apparel (especially the outer robe):—clothing, garment,
 raiment.

G1743.definition:
ἐνδυναμόω endynamóō, en-doo-nam-o'-o; from G1722 and G1412; to empower:—enable, (increase in) strength(-en),
 be (make) strong.

G1744.definition:
ἐνδύνω endýnō, en-doo'-no; from G1772 and G1416; to sink (by implication, wrap (compare G1746) on,
 i.e. (figuratively) sneak:—creep.

G1745.definition: ἔνδυσις éndysis, en'-doo-sis; from G1746; investment with clothing:—putting on.

G1746.definition:
ἐνδύω endýō, en-doo'-o; from G1722 and G1416 (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest
 with clothing (literally or figuratively):—array, clothe (with),
 endue, have (put) on.

G1747.definition:
ἐνέδρα enédra, en-ed'-rah; feminine from G1722 and the base of G1476; an ambuscade, i.e.
 (figuratively) murderous purpose:—lay wait. See also G1749.

G1748.definition:
ἐνεδρεύω enedreúō, en-ed-ryoo'-o; from G1747; to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination:—lay wait
 for.

G175.definition:
ἄκαρπος ákarpos, ak'-ar-pos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2590; barren (literally or
 figuratively):—without fruit, unfruitful.

G1750.definition: ἐνειλέω eneiléō, en-i-leh'-o; from G1772 and the base of G1507; to enwrap:—wrap in.

G1751.definition:
ἔνειμι éneimi, en'-i-mee; from G1772 and G1510; to be within (neuter participle plural):—such
 things as … have. See also G1762.

G1752.definition:
†ἕνεκα héneka, hen'-ek-ah; of uncertain affinity; on account of:—because, for (cause, sake),
 (where-)fore, by reason of, that.

G1753.definition:
ἐνέργεια enérgeia, en-erg'-i-ah; from G1756; efficiency ("energy"):—operation, strong, (effectual)
 working.

G1754.definition:
ἐνεργέω energéō, en-erg-eh'-o; from G1756; to be active, efficient:—do, (be) effectual (fervent), be
 mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

G1755.definition: ἐνέργημα enérgēma, en-erg'-ay-mah; from G1754; an effect:—operation, working.

G1756.definition: ἐνεργής energḗs, en-er-gace'; from G1722 and G2041; active, operative:—effectual, powerful.

G1757.definition: ἐνευλογέω eneulogéō, en-yoo-log-eh'-o; from G1722 and G2127; to confer a benefit on:—bless.

G1758.definition:
ἐνέχω enéchō, en-ekh'-o; from G1722 and G2192; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication,
 to keep a grudge:—entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

G1759.definition:
†ἐνθάδε entháde, en-thad'-eh; from a prolonged form of G1722; properly, within, i.e. (of place) here,
 hither:—(t-)here, hither.

G176.definition:
ἀκατάγνωστος akatágnōstos, ak-at-ag'-noce-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2607; 
 unblamable:—that cannot be condemned.

G1760.definition:
†ἐνθυμέομαι enthyméomai, en-thoo-meh'-om-ahee; from a compound of G1722 and G2372; to be inspirited, i.e.
 ponder:—think.

G1761.definition: ἐνθύμησις enthýmēsis, en-thoo'-may-sis; from G1760; deliberation:—device, thought.

G1762.definition:
ἔνι éni, en'-ee; contraction for the third person singular present indicative of G1751; 
 impersonally, there is in or among:—be, (there) is.

G1763.definition: ἐνιαυτός eniautós, en-ee-ow-tos'; prolongation from a primary ἔνος énos (a year); a year:—year.

G1764.definition:
ἐνίστημι enístēmi, en-is'-tay-mee; from G1722 and G2476; to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend,
 (participle) be instant:—come, be at hand, present.

G1765.definition:
ἐνισχύω enischýō, en-is-khoo'-o; from G1722 and G2480; to invigorate (transitively or
 reflexively):—strengthen.

G1766.definition: †ἔννατος énnatos, en'-nat-os; ordinal from G1767; ninth:—ninth.

G1767.definition: ἐννέα ennéa, en-neh'-ah; a primary number; nine:—nine.

G1769.definition:
†ἐννεός enneós, en-neh-os'; from G1770; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from
 astonishment:—speechless.

G177.definition:
ἀκατακάλυπτος akatakályptos, ak-at-ak-al'-oop-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596
 and G2572; unveiled:—uncovered.

G1770.definition:
ἐννεύω enneúō, en-nyoo'-o; from G1722 and G3506; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by
 gesture:—make signs.

G1771.definition:
ἔννοια énnoia, en'-noy-ah; from a compound of G1722 and G3563; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral
 understanding:—intent, mind.

G1772.definition:
ἔννομος énnomos, en'-nom-os; from G1722 and G3551; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject
 to:—lawful, under law.

G1773.definition:
†ἔννυχον énnychon, en'-noo-khon; neuter of a compound of G1722 and G3571; (adverbially) by night:—before
 day.

G1774.definition: ἐνοικέω enoikéō, en-oy-keh'-o; from G1722 and G3611; to inhabit (figuratively):—dwell in.

G1775.definition: ἑνότης henótēs, hen-ot-ace'; from G1520; oneness, i.e. (figuratively) unanimity:—unity.

G1776.definition:
ἐνοχλέω enochléō, en-okh-leh'-o; from G1722 and G3791; to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to
 annoy:—trouble.

G1777.definition:
ἔνοχος énochos, en'-okh-os; from G1758; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):—in danger
 of, guilty of, subject to.

G1778.definition: ἔνταλμα éntalma, en'-tal-mah; from G1781; an injunction, i.e. religious precept:—commandment.

G1779.definition:
ἐνταφιάζω entaphiázō, en-taf-ee-ad'-zo; from a compound of G1722 and G5028; to inswathe with cerements for
 interment:—bury.

G178.definition:
ἀκατάκριτος akatákritos, ak-at-ak'-ree-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632; without
 (legal) trial:—uncondemned.

G1780.definition: ἐνταφιασμός entaphiasmós, en-taf-ee-as-mos'; from G1779; preparation for interment:—burying.

G1781.definition:
ἐντέλλομαι entéllomai, en-tel'-lom-ahee; from G1722 and the base of G5056; to enjoin:—(give) charge, (give)
 command(-ments), injoin.

G1782.definition:
ἐντεῦθεν enteûthen, ent-yoo'-then; from the same as G1759; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated)
 on both sides:—(from) hence, on either side.

G1783.definition:
ἔντευξις énteuxis, ent'-yook-sis; from G1793; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:—intercession,
 prayer.

G1784.definition:
ἔντιμος éntimos, en'-tee-mos; from G1722 and G5092; valued (figuratively):—dear, more honourable,
 precious, in reputation.

G1785.definition:
ἐντολή entolḗ, en-tol-ay'; from G1781; injunction, i.e. an authoritative
 prescription:—commandment, precept.

G1786.definition: ἐντόπιος entópios, en-top'-ee-os; from G1722 and G5117; a resident:—of that place.

G1787.definition: ἐντός entós, en-tos'; from G1722; inside (adverb or noun):—within.

G1788.definition:
ἐντρέπω entrépō, en-trep'-o; from G1722 and the base of G5157; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and
 reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to
 confound:—regard, (give) reference, shame.

G1789.definition: ἐντρέφω entréphō, en-tref'-o; from G1722 and G5142; (figuratively) to educate:—nourish up in.

G179.definition:
ἀκατάλυτος akatálytos, ak-at-al'-oo-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2647; 
 indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:—endless.

G1790.definition: ἔντρομος éntromos, en'-trom-os; from G1722 and G5156; terrified:—X quake, × trembled.

G1791.definition: ἐντροπή entropḗ, en-trop-ay'; from G1788; confusion:—shame.

G1792.definition: ἐντρυφάω entrypháō, en-troo-fah'-o; from G1722 and G5171; to revel in:—sporting selves.

G1794.definition:
ἐντυλίσσω entylíssō, en-too-lis'-so; from G1722 and τυλίσσω tylíssō (to twist; probably akin to G1507); to entwine,
 i.e. wind up in:—wrap in (together).

G1795.definition:
ἐντυπόω entypóō, en-too-po'-o; from G1722 and a derivative of G5179; to enstamp, i.e.
 engrave:—engrave.

G1796.definition: ἐνυβρίζω enybrízō, en-oo-brid'-zo; from G1722 and G5195; to insult:—do despite unto.

G1797.definition: †ἐνυπνιάζομαι enypniázomai, en-oop-nee-ad'-zom-ahee; middle voice from G1798; to dream:—dream(-er).

G1798.definition:
ἐνύπνιον enýpnion, en-oop'-nee-on; from G1722 and G5258; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a
 dream):—dream.

G1799.definition:
ἐνώπιον enṓpion, en-o'-pee-on; neuter of a compound of G1722 and a derivative of G3700; in the face of
 (literally or figuratively):—before, in the presence (sight) of, to.

G18.definition:
ἀγαθός agathós, ag-ath-os'; a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):—benefit,
 good(-s, things), well. Compare G2570.

G180.definition:
†ἀκατάπαυστος akatápaustos, ak-at-ap'-ow-stos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2664; 
 unrefraining:—that cannot cease.

G1800.definition: Ἐνώς Enṓs, en-oce'; of Hebrew origin (H583); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch:—Enos.

G1801.definition:
ἐνωτίζομαι enōtízomai, en-o-tid'-zom-ahee; middle voice from a compound of G1722 and G3775; to take in one's ear,
 i.e. to listen:—hearken.

G1802.definition: Ἐνώχ Enṓch, en-oke'; of Hebrew origin (H2585); Enoch (i.e. Chanok), an antediluvian:—Enoch.

G1803.definition: ἕξ héx, hex; a primary numeral; six:—six.

G1804.definition: ἐξαγγέλλω exangéllō, ex-ang-el'-lo; from G1537 and the base of G32; to publish, i.e. celebrate:—shew forth.

G1805.definition:
ἐξαγοράζω exagorázō, ex-ag-or-ad'-zo; from G1537 and G59; to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from
 loss (improve opportunity):—redeem.

G1806.definition: ἐξάγω exágō, ex-ag'-o; from G1537 and G71; to lead forth:—bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

G1807.definition:
ἐξαιρέω exairéō, ex-ahee-reh'-o; from G1537 and G138; actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select;
 figuratively, to release:—deliver, pluck out, rescue.

G1808.definition: ἐξαίρω exaírō, ex-ah'-ee-ro; from G1537 and G142; to remove:—put (take) away.

G1809.definition: †ἐξαιτέομαι exaitéomai, ex-ahee-teh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G154; to demand (for trial):—desire.

G181.definition: ἀκαταστασία akatastasía, ak-at-as-tah-see'-ah; from G182; instability, i.e. disorder:—commotion, confusion, tumult.

G1810.definition:
ἐξαίφνης exaíphnēs, ex-ah'-eef-nace; from G1537 and the base of G160; of a sudden (unexpectedly):—suddenly. 
 Compare G1819.

G1811.definition:
ἐξακολουθέω exakolouthéō, ex-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o; from G1537 and G190; to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate,
 obey, yield to:—follow.

G1812.definition: ἑξακόσιοι hexakósioi, hex-ak-os'-ee-oy; plural ordinal from G1803 and G1540; six hundred:—six hundred.

G1813.definition:
ἐξαλείφω exaleíphō, ex-al-i'-fo; from G1537 and G218; to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears,
 figuratively, pardon sin):—blot out, wipe away.

G1814.definition: ἐξάλλομαι exállomai, ex-al'-lom-ahee; from G1537 and G242; to spring forth:—leap up.

G1815.definition: ἐξανάστασις exanástasis, ex-an-as'-tas-is; from G1817; a rising from death:—resurrection.

G1816.definition:
ἐξανατέλλω exanatéllō, ex-an-at-el'-lo; from G1537 and G393; to start up out of the ground, i.e.
 germinate:—spring up.

G1817.definition:
ἐξανίστημι exanístēmi, ex-an-is'-tay-mee; from G1537 and G450; objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget;
 subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object:—raise (rise) up.

G1818.definition: ἐξαπατάω exapatáō, ex-ap-at-ah'-o; from G1537 and G538; to seduce wholly:—beguile, deceive.

G1819.definition:
ἐξάπινα exápina, ex-ap'-ee-nah; from G1537 and a derivative of the same as G160; of a sudden, i.e.
 unexpectedly:—suddenly. Compare G1810.

G182.definition:
ἀκατάστατος akatástatos, ak-at-as'-tat-os; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2525; 
 inconstant:—unstable.

G1820.definition:
†ἐξαπορέομαι exaporéomai, ex-ap-or-eh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G639; to be utterly at a loss, i.e.
 despond:—(in) despair.

G1821.definition:
ἐξαποστέλλω exapostéllō, ex-ap-os-tel'-lo; from G1537 and G649; to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to
 despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss:—send (away, forth, out).

G1822.definition:
ἐξαρτίζω exartízō, ex-ar-tid'-zo; from G1537 and a derivative of G739; to finish out (time); figuratively,
 to equip fully (a teacher):—accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

G1823.definition:
ἐξαστράπτω exastráptō, ex-as-trap'-to; from G1537 and G797; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant
 (of very white garments):—glistening.

G1824.definition:
ἐξαυτῆς exautēs, ex-ow'-tace; from G1537 and the genitive case singular feminine of G846 (G5610 being
 understood); from that hour, i.e. instantly:—by and by, immediately,
 presently, straightway.

G1825.definition:
ἐξεγείρω exegeírō, ex-eg-i'-ro; from G1537 and G1453; to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate
 (from death), release (from infliction):—raise up.

G1826.definition:
ἔξειμι éxeimi, ex'-i-mee; from G1537 and εἶμι eîmi (to go); to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to
 the shore):—depart, get (to land), go out.

G1828.definition:
ἐξέλκω exélkō, ex-el'-ko; from G1537 and G1670; to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to
 sin):—draw away.

G1829.definition:
ἐξέραμα exérama, ex-er'-am-ah; from a comparative of G1537 and a presumed ἐράω eráō (to spue); vomit, i.e.
 food disgorged:—vomit.

G1830.definition: †ἐξερευνάω exereunáō, ex-er-yoo-nah'-o; from G1537 and G2045; to explore (figuratively):—search diligently.

G1831.definition:
†ἐξέρχομαι exérchomai, ex-er'-khom-ahee; from G1537 and G2064; to issue (literally or figuratively):—come
 (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away,
 forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

G1832.definition:
ἔξεστι éxesti, ex'-es-tee; third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 and
 G1510; so also
    ἐξόν exón  ex-on'
 neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of
 G1510 expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative
 idea of being out in public):—be lawful, let,
 × may(-est).

G1833.definition:
ἐξετάζω exetázō, ex-et-ad'-zo; from G1537 and ἐτάζω etázō (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions),
 i.e. ascertain or interrogate:—ask, enquire, search.

G1834.definition:
ἐξηγέομαι exēgéomai, ex-ayg-eh'-om-ahee; from G1537 and G2233; to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse,
 unfold:—declare, tell.

G1835.definition: ἑξήκοντα hexḗkonta, hex-ay'-kon-tah; the tenth multiple of G1803; sixty:—sixty(-fold), threescore.

G1836.definition:
ἑξῆς hexēs, hex-ace'; from G2192 (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); 
 successive:—after, following, × morrow, next.

G1837.definition:
†ἐξηχέομαι exēchéomai, ex-ay-kheh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1537 and G2278; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be
 generally reported):—sound forth.

G1838.definition: ἕξις héxis, hex'-is; from G2192; habit, i.e. (by implication) practice:—use.

G1839.definition:
ἐξίστημι exístēmi, ex-is'-tay-mee; from G1537 and G2476; to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or
 (reflexively) become astounded, insane:—amaze, be (make) astonished,
 be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

G184.definition:
†Ἀκελδαμά Akeldamá, ak-el-dam-ah'; of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to H2506 and
 H1818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem:—Aceldama.

G1840.definition:
ἐξισχύω exischýō, ex-is-khoo'-o; from G1537 and G2480; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely
 competent:—be able.

G1841.definition:
ἔξοδος éxodos, ex'-od-os; from G1537 and G3598; an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death:—decease,
 departing.

G1842.definition: †ἐξολοθρεύω exolothreúō, ex-ol-oth-ryoo'-o; from G1537 and G3645; to extirpate:—destroy.

G1843.definition:
ἐξομολογέω exomologéō, ex-om-ol-og-eh'-o; from G1537 and G3670; to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent)
 agree fully:—confess, profess, promise.

G1844.definition: ἐξορκίζω exorkízō, ex-or-kid'-zo; from G1537 and G3726; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure:—adjure.

G1845.definition:
ἐξορκιστής exorkistḗs, ex-or-kis-tace'; from G1844; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication)
 an "exorcist" (conjurer):—exorcist.

G1846.definition:
ἐξορύσσω exorýssō, ex-or-oos'-so; from G1537 and G3736; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an
 eye), remove (roofing):—break up, pluck out.

G1847.definition:
†ἐξουδενόω exoudenóō, ex-oo-den-o'-o; from G1537 and a derivative of the neuter of G3762; to make utterly
 nothing of, i.e. despise:—set at nought. See also G1848.

G1848.definition:
ἐξουθενέω exouthenéō, ex-oo-then-eh'-o; a variation of G1847 and meaning the same:—contemptible, despise,
 least esteemed, set at nought.

G1849.definition:
ἐξουσία exousía, ex-oo-see'-ah; from G1832 (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively)
 force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery
 (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control),
 delegated influence:—authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right,
 strength.

G185.definition:
ἀκέραιος akéraios, ak-er'-ah-yos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; 
 unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent:—harmless, simple.

G1850.definition:
ἐξουσιάζω exousiázō, ex-oo-see-ad'-zo; from G1849; to control:—exercise authority upon, bring under the
 (have) power of.

G1851.definition:
ἐξοχή exochḗ, ex-okh-ay'; from a compound of G1537 and G2192 (meaning to stand out); prominence
 (figuratively):—principal.

G1852.definition: ἐξυπνίζω exypnízō, ex-oop-nid'-zo; from G1853; to waken:—awake out of sleep.

G1853.definition: ἔξυπνος éxypnos, ex'-oop-nos; from G1537 and G5258; awake:—X out of sleep.

G1854.definition:
ἔξω éxō, ex'-o; adverb from G1537; out(-side, of doors), literally or
 figuratively:—away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.

G1855.definition:
ἔξωθεν éxōthen, ex'-o-then; from G1854; external(-ly):—out(-side, -ward, - wardly), (from)
 without.

G1856.definition:
†ἐξωθέω exōthéō, ex-o-theh'-o; from G1537 and ὠθέω ōthéō (to push); to expel; by implication, to
 propel:—drive out, thrust in.

G1857.definition: ἐξώτερος exṓteros, ex-o'-ter-os; comparative of G1854; exterior:—outer.

G1858.definition: ἑορτάζω heortázō, heh-or-tad'-zo; from G1859; to observe a festival:—keep the feast.

G1859.definition: ἑορτή heortḗ, heh-or-tay'; of uncertain affinity; a festival:—feast, holyday.

G186.definition:
ἀκλινής aklinḗs, ak-lee-nace'; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2827; not leaning, i.e.
 (figuratively) firm:—without wavering.

G1860.definition:
ἐπαγγελία epangelía, ep-ang-el-ee'-ah; from G1861; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge;
 especially a divine assurance of good):—message, promise.

G1861.definition:
†ἐπαγγέλλω epangéllō, ep-ang-el'-lo; from G1909 and the base of G32; to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by
 implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting
 oneself:—profess, (make) promise.

G1862.definition:
ἐπάγγελμα epángelma, ep-ang'-el-mah; from G1861; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some
 good):—promise.

G1863.definition:
ἐπάγω epágō, ep-ag'-o; from G1909 and G71; to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a
 crime):—bring upon.

G1864.definition: ἐπαγωνίζομαι epagōnízomai, ep-ag-o-nid'-zom-ahee; from G1909 and G75; to struggle for:—earnestly contend for.

G1865.definition:
ἐπαθροίζω epathroízō, ep-ath-roid'-zo; from G1909 and ἀθροίζω athroízō (to assemble); to accumulate:—gather thick
 together.

G1866.definition: Ἐπαίνετος Epaínetos, ep-a'-hee-net-os; from G1867; praised; Epænetus, a Christian:—Epenetus.

G1867.definition: ἐπαινέω epainéō, ep-ahee-neh'-o; from G1909 and G134; to applaud:—commend, laud, praise.

G1868.definition:
ἔπαινος épainos, ep'-ahee-nos; from G1909 and the base of G134; laudation; concretely, a commendable
 thing:—praise.

G1869.definition:
ἐπαίρω epaírō, ep-ahee'-ro; from G1909 and G142; to raise up (literally or figuratively):—exalt
 self, poise (lift, take) up.

G187.definition:
ἀκμάζω akmázō, ak-mad'-zo; from the same as G188; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:—be
 fully ripe.

G1870.definition: ἐπαισχύνομαι epaischýnomai, ep-ahee-skhoo'-nom-ahee; from G1909 and G153; to feel shame for something:—be ashamed.

G1871.definition: ἐπαιτέω epaitéō, ep-ahee-teh'-o; from G1909 and G154; to ask for:—beg.

G1872.definition: ἐπακολουθέω epakolouthéō, ep-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o; from G1909 and G190; to accompany:—follow (after).

G1873.definition: ἐπακούω epakoúō, ep-ak-oo'-o; from G1909 and G191; to hearken (favorably) to:—hear.

G1874.definition: ἐπακροάομαι epakroáomai, ep-ak-ro-ah'-om-ahee; from G1909 and the base of G202; to listen (intently) to:—hear.

G1875.definition:
ἐπάν epán, ep-an'; from G1909 and G302; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness;
 whenever, as soon as:—when.

G1876.definition:
ἐπάναγκες epánankes, ep-an'-ang-kes; neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 and G318; (adverbially) on
 necessity, i.e. necessarily:—necessary.

G1877.definition:
ἐπανάγω epanágō, ep-an-ag'-o; from G1909 and G321; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to
 sea); (intransitively) to return:—launch (thrust) out, return.

G1878.definition: †ἐπαναμιμνήσκω epanamimnḗskō, ep-an-ah-mim-nace'-ko; from G1909 and G363; to remind of:—put in mind.

G1879.definition:
ἐπαναπαύομαι epanapaúomai, ep-an-ah-pow'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G373; to settle on; literally (remain) or
 figuratively (rely):—rest in (upon).

G188.definition:
†ἀκμήν akmḗn, ak-mane'; accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ἀκή akḗ (a point) and meaning
 the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still:—yet.

G1880.definition: ἐπανέρχομαι epanérchomai, ep-an-er'-khom-ahee; from G1909 and G424; to come up on, i.e. return:—come again, return.

G1881.definition:
†ἐπανίσταμαι epanístamai, ep-an-is'-tam-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G450; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to
 attack:—rise up against.

G1882.definition:
ἐπανόρθωσις epanórthōsis, ep-an-or'-tho-sis; from a compound of G1909 and G461; a straightening up again, i.e.
 (figuratively) rectification (reformation):—correction.

G1883.definition:
ἐπάνω epánō, ep-an'-o; from G1909 and G507; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank,
 etc.):—above, more than, (up-)on, over.

G1884.definition: ἐπαρκέω eparkéō, ep-ar-keh'-o; from G1909 and G714; to avail for, i.e. help:—relieve.

G1885.definition:
†ἐπαρχία eparchía, ep-ar-khee'-ah; from a compound of G1909 and G757 (meaning a governor of a district,
 "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman
 præfecture:—province.

G1886.definition:
ἔπαυλις épaulis, ep'-ow-lis; from G1909 and an equivalent of G833; a hut over the head, i.e. a
 dwelling:—habitation.

G1887.definition:
ἐπαύριον epaúrion, ep-ow'-ree-on; from G1909 and G839; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (G2250 being
 implied) to-morrow:—day following, morrow, next day (after).

G1889.definition: Ἐπαφρᾶς Epaphrâs, ep-af-ras'; contracted from G1891; Epaphras, a Christian:—Epaphras.

G189.definition:
ἀκοή akoḗ, ak-o-ay'; from G191; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):—audience,
 ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

G1890.definition:
ἐπαφρίζω epaphrízō, ep-af-rid'-zo; from G1909 and G875; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a
 vile passion):—foam out.

G1891.definition:
Ἐπαφρόδιτος Epaphróditos, ep-af-rod'-ee-tos; from G1909 (in the sense of devoted to) and Ἀφροδίτη Aphrodítē (Venus); 
 Epaphroditus, a Christian:—Epaphroditus. Compare G1889.

G1892.definition:
ἐπεγείρω epegeírō, ep-eg-i'-ro; from G1909 and G1453; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite
 against:—raise, stir up.

G1893.definition:
ἐπεί epeí, ep-i'; from G1909 and G1487; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or
 cause):—because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing
 that, since, when.

G1894.definition:
ἐπειδή epeidḗ, ep-i-day'; from G1893 and G1211; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause)
 whereas:—after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

G1895.definition: ἐπειδήπερ epeidḗper, ep-i-day'-per; from G1894 and G4007; since indeed (of cause):—forasmuch.

G1896.definition:
ἐπεῖδον epeîdon, ep-i'-don; and other moods and persons of the same tense; from G1909 and G1492; to
 regard (favorably or otherwise):—behold, look upon.

G1898.definition: ἐπεισαγωγή epeisagōgḗ, ep-ice-ag-o-gay'; from a compound of G1909 and G1521; a superintroduction:—bringing in.

G1899.definition: ἔπειτα épeita, ep'-i-tah; from G1909 and G1534; thereafter:—after that(-ward), then.

G19.definition: ἀγαθωσύνη agathōsýnē, ag-ath-o-soo'-nay; from G18; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence:—goodness.

G190.definition:
ἀκολουθέω akolouthéō, ak-ol-oo-theh'-o; from G1 (as a particle of union) and κέλευθος kéleuthos (a road); properly, to
 be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a
 disciple):—follow, reach.

G1900.definition:
ἐπέκεινα epékeina, ep-ek'-i-nah; from G1909 and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565; upon those
 parts of, i.e. on the further side of:—beyond.

G1901.definition:
ἐπεκτείνομαι epekteínomai, ep-ek-ti'-nom-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G1614; to stretch (oneself) forward
 upon:—reach forth.

G1902.definition:
†ἐπενδύομαι ependýomai, ep-en-doo'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G1746; to invest upon oneself:—be clothed
 upon.

G1903.definition: ἐπενδύτης ependýtēs, ep-en-doo'-tace; from G1902; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment:—fisher's coat.

G1904.definition:
†ἐπέρχομαι epérchomai, ep-er'-khom-ahee; from G1909 and G2064; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack,
 (figuratively) influence:—come (in, upon).

G1905.definition:
ἐπερωτάω eperōtáō, ep-er-o-tah'-o; from G1909 and G2065; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek:—ask (after,
 questions), demand, desire, question.

G1906.definition: ἐπερώτημα eperṓtēma, ep-er-o'-tay-mah; from G1905; an inquiry:—answer.

G1907.definition:
ἐπέχω epéchō, ep-ekh'-o; from G1909 and G2192; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by
 extension) to detain; (with implication, of G3563) to pay attention
 to:—give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

G1908.definition:
ἐπηρεάζω epēreázō, ep-ay-reh-ad'-zo; from a comparative of G1909 and (probably) ἀρειά areiá (threats); to insult,
 slander:—use despitefully, falsely accuse.

G1909.definition:
ἐπί epí, ep-ee'; a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time,
 place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive
 case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on,
 etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon,
 etc.:—about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as
 (touching), at, beside, × have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a
 place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf
 of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward),
 with.

G191.definition:
ἀκούω akoúō, ak-oo'-o; a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):—give (in the) audience
 (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be
 reported, understand.

G1910.definition:
ἐπιβαίνω epibaínō, ep-ee-bah'-ee-no; from G1909 and the base of G939; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend,
 embark, arrive:—come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take
 ship.

G1911.definition:
ἐπιβάλλω epibállō, ep-ee-bal'-lo; from G1909 and G906; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or
 reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with G1438
 implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to:—beat into, cast
 (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

G1912.definition:
ἐπιβαρέω epibaréō, ep-ee-bar-eh'-o; from G1909 and G916; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be
 expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards:—be chargeable to,
 overcharge.

G1913.definition:
ἐπιβιβάζω epibibázō, ep-ee-bee-bad'-zo; from G1909 and a reduplicated derivative of the base of G939 (compare
 G307); to cause to mount (an animal):—set on.

G1914.definition:
ἐπιβλέπω epiblépō, ep-ee-blep'-o; from G1909 and G991; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality):—look
 upon, regard, have respect to.

G1915.definition: ἐπίβλημα epíblēma, ep-ib'-lay-mah; from G1911; a patch:—piece.

G1917.definition:
ἐπιβουλή epiboulḗ, ep-ee-boo-lay'; from a presumed compound of G1909 and G1014; a plan against someone,
 i.e. a plot:—laying (lying) in wait.

G1918.definition:
ἐπιγαμβρεύω epigambreúō, ep-ee-gam-bryoo'-o; from G1909 and a derivative of G1062; to form affinity with, i.e.
 (specially) in a levirate way:—marry.

G1919.definition:
ἐπίγειος epígeios, ep-ig'-i-os; from G1909 and G1093; worldly (physically or morally):—earthly, in
 earth, terrestrial.

G192.definition: ἀκρασία akrasía, ak-ras-ee'-a; from G193; want of self-restraint:—excess, incontinency.

G1920.definition: ἐπιγίνομαι epigínomai, ep-ig-in'-om-ahee; from G1909 and G1096; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind):—blow.

G1921.definition:
ἐπιγινώσκω epiginṓskō, ep-ig-in-oce'-ko; from G1909 and G1097; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by
 implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge:—(ac-,
 have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.

G1922.definition:
ἐπίγνωσις epígnōsis, ep-ig'-no-sis; from G1921; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment,
 acknowledgement:—(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

G1923.definition: ἐπιγραφή epigraphḗ, ep-ig-raf-ay'; from G1924; an inscription:—superscription.

G1924.definition:
ἐπιγράφω epigráphō, ep-ee-graf'-o; from G1909 and G1125; to inscribe (physically or
 mentally):—inscription, write in (over, thereon).

G1925.definition: ἐπιδείκνυμι epideíknymi, ep-ee-dike'-noo-mee; from G1909 and G1166; to exhibit (physically or mentally):—shew.

G1926.definition:
ἐπιδέχομαι epidéchomai, ep-ee-dekh'-om-ahee; from G1909 and G1209; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively)
 teacher):—receive.

G1927.definition:
ἐπιδημέω epidēméō, ep-ee-day-meh'-o; from a compound of G1909 and G1218; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by
 extension) to reside (in a foreign country):—(be) dwelling (which
 were) there, stranger.

G1928.definition:
ἐπιδιατάσσομαι epidiatássomai, ep-ee-dee-ah-tas'-som-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G1299; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement
 (as a codicil):—add to.

G1929.definition:
ἐπιδίδωμι epidídōmi, ep-ee-did'-o-mee; from G1909 and G1325; to give over (by hand or surrender):—deliver
 unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.

G193.definition:
ἀκρατής akratḗs, ak-rat'-ace; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2904; powerless, i.e. without
 self-control:—incontinent.

G1930.definition:
ἐπιδιορθόω epidiorthóō, ep-ee-dee-or-tho'-o; from G1909 and a derivative of G3717; to straighten further, i.e.
 (figuratively) arrange additionally:—set in order.

G1931.definition: ἐπιδύω epidýō, ep-ee-doo'-o; from G1909 and G1416; to set fully (as the sun):—go down.

G1932.definition:
ἐπιείκεια epieíkeia, ep-ee-i'-ki-ah; from G1933; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity,
 mildness:—clemency, gentleness.

G1933.definition:
ἐπιεικής epieikḗs, ep-ee-i-kace'; from G1909 and G1503; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild:—gentle,
 moderation, patient.

G1934.definition:
ἐπιζητέω epizētéō, ep-eed-zay-teh'-o; from G1909 and G2212; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand,
 to crave:—desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

G1935.definition: ἐπιθανάτιος epithanátios, ep-ee-than-at'-ee-os; from G1909 and G2288; doomed to death:—appointed to death.

G1936.definition: ἐπίθεσις epíthesis, ep-ith'-es-is; from G2007; an imposition (of hands officially):—laying (putting) on.

G1937.definition:
ἐπιθυμέω epithyméō, ep-ee-thoo-meh'-o; from G1909 and G2372; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully
 or otherwise):—covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

G1938.definition: ἐπιθυμητής epithymētḗs, ep-ee-thoo-may-tace'; from G1937; a craver:—+ lust after.

G1939.definition:
ἐπιθυμία epithymía, ep-ee-thoo-mee'-ah; from G1937; a longing (especially for what is
 forbidden):—concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

G194.definition:
ἄκρατος ákratos, ak'-rat-os; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; 
 undiluted:—without mixture.

G1940.definition: ἐπικαθίζω epikathízō, ep-ee-kath-id'-zo; from G1909 and G2523; to seat upon:—set on.

G1941.definition:
†ἐπικαλέομαι epikaléomai, ep-ee-kal-eh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G2564; to entitle; by implication, to invoke
 (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):—appeal (unto), call
 (on, upon), surname.

G1942.definition: †ἐπικάλυμα epikályma, ep-ee-kal'-oo-mah; from G1943; a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext:—cloke.

G1943.definition: ἐπικαλύπτω epikalýptō, ep-ee-kal-oop'-to; from G1909 and G2572; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:—cover.

G1944.definition:
†ἐπικατάρατος epikatáratos, ep-ee-kat-ar'-at-os; from G1909 and a derivative of G2672; imprecated, i.e.
 execrable:—accursed.

G1945.definition:
ἐπίκειμαι epíkeimai, ep-ik'-i-mahee; from G1909 and G2749; to rest upon (literally or figuratively):—impose,
 be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on),
 press upon.

G1946.definition:
Ἐπικούρειος Epikoúreios, ep-ee-koo'-ri-os; from Ἐπίκουρος Epíkouros (compare G1947) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or
 follower of Epicurus:—Epicurean.

G1947.definition:
ἐπικουρία epikouría, ep-ee-koo-ree'-ah; from a compound of G1909 and a (prolonged) form of the base of G2877 (in
 the sense of servant); assistance:—help.

G1948.definition: ἐπικρίνω epikrínō, ep-ee-kree'-no; from G1909 and G2919; to adjudge:—give sentence.

G1949.definition:
†ἐπιλαμβάνομαι epilambánomai, ep-ee-lam-ban'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G2983; to seize (for help, injury,
 attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively):—catch,
 lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).

G195.definition: ἀκρίβεια akríbeia, ak-ree'-bi-ah; from the same as G196; exactness:—perfect manner.

G1950.definition:
ἐπιλανθάνομαι epilanthánomai, ep-ee-lan-than'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G2990; to lose out of mind; by implication,
 to neglect:—(be) forget(-ful of).

G1951.definition: †ἐπιλέγομαι epilégomai, ep-ee-leg'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and G3004; to surname, select:—call, choose.

G1952.definition:
ἐπιλείπω epileípō, ep-ee-li'-po; from G1909 and G3007; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be
 insufficient for:—fail.

G1953.definition: ἐπιλησμονή epilēsmonḗ, ep-ee-lace-mon-ay'; from a derivative of G1950; negligence:—X forgetful.

G1954.definition: ἐπίλοιπος epíloipos, ep-il'-oy-pos; from G1909 and G3062; left over, i.e. remaining:—rest.

G1955.definition: ἐπίλυσις epílysis, ep-il'-oo-sis; from G1956; explanation, i.e. application:—interpretation.

G1956.definition:
ἐπιλύω epilýō, ep-ee-loo'-o; from G1909 and G3089; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain,
 decide:—determine, expound.

G1957.definition: ἐπιμαρτυρέω epimartyréō, ep-ee-mar-too-reh'-o; from G1909 and G3140; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:—testify.

G1958.definition:
ἐπιμέλεια epiméleia, ep-ee-mel'-i-ah; from G1959; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):—+ refresh
 self.

G1959.definition:
†ἐπιμελέομαι epimeléomai, ep-ee-mel-eh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and the same as G3199; to care for (physically
 or otherwise):—take care of.

G196.definition:
†ἀκριβέστατος akribéstatos, ak-ree-bes'-ta-tos; superlative of ἀκρίβης akríbēs (a derivative of the same as G206); most
 exact:—most straitest.

G1960.definition: ἐπιμελῶς epimelōs, ep-ee-mel-oce'; adverb from a derivative of G1959; carefully:—diligently.

G1961.definition:
ἐπιμένω epiménō, ep-ee-men'-o; from G1909 and G3306; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively,
 persevere):—abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

G1962.definition:
ἐπινεύω epineúō, ep-een-yoo'-o; from G1909 and G3506; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to
 assent:—consent.

G1963.definition:
ἐπίνοια epínoia, ep-in'-oy-ah; from G1909 and G3563; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication)
 purpose:—thought.

G1964.definition: ἐπιορκέω epiorkéō, ep-ee-or-keh'-o; from G1965; to commit perjury:—forswear self.

G1965.definition:
ἐπίορκος epíorkos, ep-ee'-or-kos; from G1909 and G3727; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:—perjured
 person.

G1966.definition:
†ἐπιοῦσα epioûsa, ep-ee-oo'-sah; feminine singular participle of a comparative of G1909 and
 εἶμι eîmi (to go); supervening, i.e. (G2250 or G3571 being expressed
 or implied) the ensuing day or night:—following, next.

G1967.definition:
ἐπιούσιος epioúsios, ep-ee-oo'-see-os; perhaps from the same as G1966; tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909
 and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510; for
 subsistence, i.e. needful:—daily.

G1968.definition:
ἐπιπίπτω epipíptō, ep-ee-pip'-to; from G1909 and G4098; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or
 less violence; literally or figuratively):—fall into (on, upon) lie
 on, press upon.

G1969.definition:
ἐπιπλήσσω epiplḗssō, ep-ee-place'-so; from G1909 and G4141; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to
 upbraid:—rebuke.

G1971.definition:
ἐπιποθέω epipothéō, ep-ee-poth-eh'-o; from G1909 and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave
 possession (lawfully or wrongfully):—(earnestly) desire (greatly),
 (greatly) long (after), lust.

G1972.definition: ἐπιπόθησις epipóthēsis, ep-ee-poth'-ay-sis; from G1971; a longing for:—earnest (vehement) desire.

G1973.definition:
ἐπιπόθητος epipóthētos, ep-ee-poth'-ay-tos; from G1909 and a derivative of the latter part of G1971; yearned upon,
 i.e. greatly loved:—longed for.

G1974.definition: ἐπιποθία epipothía, ep-ee-poth-ee'-ah; from G1971; intense longing:—great desire.

G1975.definition: ἐπιπορεύομαι epiporeúomai, ep-ee-por-yoo'-om-ahee; from G1909 and G4198; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach):—come.

G1976.definition:
†ἐπιῤῥάπτω epirrháptō, ep-ir-hrap'-to; from G1909 and the base of G4476; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the
 needle:—sew on.

G1977.definition:
†ἐπιῤῥίπτω epirrhíptō, ep-ir-hrip'-to; from G1909 and G4496; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):—cast
 upon.

G1978.definition:
ἐπίσημος epísēmos, ep-is'-ay-mos; from G1909 and some form of the base of G4591; remarkable, i.e.
 (figuratively) eminent:—notable, of note.

G1979.definition:
ἐπισιτισμός episitismós, ep-ee-sit-is-mos'; from a compound of G1909 and a derivative of G4621; a provisioning, i.e.
 (concretely) food:—victuals.

G198.definition:
ἀκριβόω akribóō, ak-ree-bo'-o; from the same as G196; to be exact, i.e. ascertain:—enquire
 diligently.

G1980.definition:
ἐπισκέπτομαι episképtomai, ep-ee-skep'-tom-ahee; middle voice from G1909 and the base of G4649; to inspect, i.e. (by
 implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve:—look
 out, visit.

G1981.definition:
ἐπισκηνόω episkēnóō, ep-ee-skay-no'-o; from G1909 and G4637; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with
:—rest upon.

G1982.definition:
ἐπισκιάζω episkiázō, ep-ee-skee-ad'-zo; from G1909 and a derivative of G4639; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by
 analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest
 with preternatural influence:—overshadow.

G1983.definition:
ἐπισκοπέω episkopéō, ep-ee-skop-eh'-o; from G1909 and G4648; to oversee; by implication, to beware:—look
 diligently, take the oversight.

G1985.definition:
ἐπίσκοπος epískopos, ep-is'-kop-os; from G1909 and G4649 (in the sense of G1983); a superintendent, i.e.
 Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church
 (literally or figuratively):—bishop, overseer.

G1986.definition:
ἐπισπάομαι epispáomai, ep-ee-spah'-om-ahee; from G1909 and G4685; to draw over, i.e. (with G203 implied) efface the
 mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):—become
 uncircumcised.

G1987.definition:
ἐπίσταμαι epístamai, ep-is'-tam-ahee; apparently a middle voice of G2186 (with G3563 implied); to put the mind
 upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with:—know, understand.

G1988.definition:
ἐπιστάτης epistátēs, ep-is-tat'-ace; from G1909 and a presumed derivative of G2476; an appointee over, i.e.
 commander (teacher):—master.

G1989.definition:
ἐπιστέλλω epistéllō, ep-ee-stel'-lo; from G1909 and G4724; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to
 communicate by letter (for any purpose):—write (a letter, unto).

G199.definition:
ἀκριβῶς akribōs, ak-ree-boce'; adverb from the same as G196; exactly:—circumspectly, diligently,
 perfect(-ly).

G1990.definition: ἐπιστήμων epistḗmōn, ep-ee-stay'-mone; from G1987; intelligent:—endued with knowledge.

G1991.definition:
ἐπιστηρίζω epistērízō, ep-ee-stay-rid'-zo; from G1909 and G4741; to support further, i.e. reestablish:—confirm,
 strengthen.

G1992.definition: ἐπιστολή epistolḗ, ep-is-tol-ay'; from G1989; a written message:—"epistle," letter.

G1993.definition:
ἐπιστομίζω epistomízō, ep-ee-stom-id'-zo; from G1909 and G4750; to put something over the mouth, i.e.
 (figuratively) to silence:—stop mouths.

G1994.definition:
ἐπιστρέφω epistréphō, ep-ee-stref'-o; from G1909 and G4762; to revert (literally, figuratively or
 morally):—come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).

G1995.definition: ἐπιστροφή epistrophḗ, ep-is-trof-ay'; from G1994; reversion, i.e. morally, revolution:—conversion.

G1996.definition:
ἐπισυνάγω episynágō, ep-ee-soon-ag'-o; from G1909 and G4863; to collect upon the same place:—gather
 (together).

G1997.definition:
ἐπισυναγωγή episynagōgḗ, ep-ee-soon-ag-o-gay'; from G1996; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for
 worship):—assembling (gathering) together.

G1998.definition:
ἐπισυντρέχω episyntréchō, ep-ee-soon-trekh'-o; from G1909 and G4936; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular
 occasion):—come running together.

G2.definition: Ἀαρών Aarṓn, ah-ar-ohn'; of Hebrew origin (H175); Aaron, the brother of Moses:—Aaron.

G20.definition: ἀγαλλίασις agallíasis, ag-al-lee'-as-is; from G21; exultation; specially, welcome:—gladness, (exceeding) joy.

G200.definition:
ἀκρίς akrís, ak-rece'; apparently from the same as G206; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting
 on the top of vegetation):—locust.

G2000.definition:
ἐπισφαλής episphalḗs, ep-ee-sfal-ace'; from a compound of G1909 and σφάλλω sphállō (to trip); figuratively,
 insecure:—dangerous.

G2001.definition:
ἐπισχύω epischýō, ep-is-khoo'-o; from G1909 and G2480; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist
 stoutly:—be the more fierce.

G2002.definition:
ἐπισωρεύω episōreúō, ep-ee-so-ryoo'-o; from G1909 and G4987; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek
 additionally:—heap.

G2003.definition:
ἐπιταγή epitagḗ, ep-ee-tag-ay'; from G2004; an injunction or decree; by implication,
 authoritativeness:—authority, commandment.

G2004.definition:
ἐπιτάσσω epitássō, ep-ee-tas'-so; from G1909 and G5021; to arrange upon, i.e. order:—charge, command,
 injoin.

G2006.definition:
ἐπιτήδειος epitḗdeios, ep-ee-tay'-di-os; from ἐπιτηδές epitēdés (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication)
 requisite:—things which are needful.

G2007.definition:
ἐπιτίθημι epitíthēmi, ep-ee-tith'-ay-mee; from G1909 and G5087; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):—add
 unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up),
 + surname, × wound.

G2008.definition:
ἐπιτιμάω epitimáō, ep-ee-tee-mah'-o; from G1909 and G5091; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by
 implication, forbid:—(straitly) charge, rebuke.

G2009.definition:
ἐπιτιμία epitimía, ep-ee-tee-mee'-ah; from a compound of G1909 and G5092; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship;
 used (in the sense of G2008) of a penalty:—punishment.

G201.definition: ἀκροατήριον akroatḗrion, ak-ro-at-ay'-ree-on; from G202; an audience-room:—place of hearing.

G2010.definition:
ἐπιτρέπω epitrépō, ep-ee-trep'-o; from G1909 and the base of G5157; to turn over (transfer), i.e.
 allow:—give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

G2011.definition: ἐπιτροπή epitropḗ, ep-ee-trop-ay'; from G2010; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:—commission.

G2012.definition:
ἐπίτροπος epítropos, ep-it'-rop-os; from G1909 and G5158 (in the sense of G2011); a commissioner, i.e.
 domestic manager, guardian:—steward, tutor.

G2013.definition:
ἐπιτυγχάνω epitynchánō, ep-ee-toong-khan'-o; from G1909 and G5177; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to
 attain:—obtain.

G2014.definition:
ἐπιφαίνω epiphaínō, ep-ee-fah'-ee-no; from G1909 and G5316; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or
 (figuratively) known:—appear, give light.

G2015.definition:
ἐπιφάνεια epipháneia, ep-if-an'-i-ah; from G2016; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ
 (past or future):—appearing, brightness.

G2016.definition: ἐπιφανής epiphanḗs, ep-if-an-ace'; from G2014; conspicuous, i.e. (figuratively) memorable:—notable.

G2017.definition: †ἐπιφαύω epiphaúō, ep-ee-fow'-o; a form of G2014; to illuminate (figuratively):—give light.

G2018.definition:
ἐπιφέρω epiphérō, ep-ee-fer'-o; from G1909 and G5342; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally
 or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:—add, bring (against),
 take.

G2019.definition:
ἐπιφωνέω epiphōnéō, ep-ee-fo-neh'-o; from G1909 and G5455; to call at something, i.e. exclaim:—cry
 (against), give a shout.

G202.definition:
ἀκροατής akroatḗs, ak-ro-at-ace'; from ἀκροάομαι akroáomai (to listen; apparently an intensive of G191); a hearer
 (merely):—hearer.

G2020.definition: ἐπιφώσκω epiphṓskō, ep-ee-foce'-ko; a form of G2017; to begin to grow light:—begin to dawn, × draw on.

G2021.definition:
ἐπιχειρέω epicheiréō, ep-ee-khi-reh'-o; from G1909 and G5495; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake:—go about,
 take in hand (upon).

G2022.definition: ἐπιχέω epichéō, ep-ee-kheh'-o; from G1909 and χέω chéō (to pour);  --to pour upon:—pour in.

G2023.definition:
ἐπιχορηγέω epichorēgéō, ep-ee-khor-ayg-eh'-o; from G1909 and G5524; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply,
 (figuratively) aid or contribute:—add, minister (nourishment, unto).

G2024.definition: ἐπιχορηγία epichorēgía, ep-ee-khor-ayg-ee'-ah; from G2023; contribution:—supply.

G2025.definition: ἐπιχρίω epichríō, ep-ee-khree'-o; from G1909 and G5548; to smear over:—anoint.

G2026.definition:
ἐποικοδομέω epoikodoméō, ep-oy-kod-om-eh'-o; from G1909 and G3618; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear
 up:—build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

G2027.definition:
†ἐποκέλλω epokéllō, ep-ok-el'-lo; from G1909 and ὀκέλλω okéllō (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach
 a vessel:—run aground.

G2028.definition: ἐπονομάζω eponomázō, ep-on-om-ad'-zo; from G1909 and G3687; to name further, i.e. denominate:—call.

G2029.definition: ἐποπτεύω epopteúō, ep-opt-yoo'-o; from G1909 and a derivative of G3700; to inspect, i.e. watch:—behold.

G203.definition:
ἀκροβυστία akrobystía, ak-rob-oos-tee'-ah; from G206 and probably a modified form of πόσθη pósthē (the penis or male
 sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e.
 gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:—not
 circumcised, uncircumcised (with G2192), uncircumcision.

G2030.definition:
ἐπόπτης epóptēs, ep-op'-tace; from G1909 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a
 looker-on:—eye-witness.

G2031.definition: ἔπος épos, ep'-os; from G2036; a word:—X say.

G2032.definition: ἐπουράνιος epouránios, ep-oo-ran'-ee-os; from G1909 and G3772; above the sky:—celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

G2033.definition: ἑπτά heptá, hep-tah'; a primary number; seven:—seven.

G2034.definition: ἑπτάκις heptákis, hep-tak-is'; adverb from G2033; seven times:—seven times.
