G370.definition: ἀνάξιος anáxios, an-ax'-ee-os; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G514; unfit:—unworthy.

G3700.definition:
ὀπτάνομαι optánomai, op-tan'-om-ahee; a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice)
    ὄπτομαι óptomai  op'-tom-ahee;  which is used for it in certain
                  tenses; and both as alternate of
                  G3708; 

 to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and
 thus differing from G991, which denotes simply voluntary observation;
 and from G1492, which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual
 vision; while G2300, and still more emphatically its intensive G2334,
 signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and G4648 a
 watching from a distance):—appear, look, see, shew self.

G3701.definition:
ὀπτασία optasía, op-tas-ee'-ah; from a presumed derivative of G3700; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an
 apparition:—vision.

G3702.definition:
ὀπτός optós, op-tos'; from an obsolete verb akin to ἕπσω hépsō (to "steep"); cooked, i.e.
 roasted:—broiled.

G3703.definition:
ὀπώρα opṓra, op-o'-rah; apparently from the base of G3796 and G5610; properly, even-tide of the
 (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:—fruit.

G3704.definition:
ὅπως hópōs, hop'-oce; from G3739 and G4459; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as
 adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or
 actual):—because, how, (so) that, to, when.

G3705.definition:
ὅραμα hórama, hor'-am-ah; from G3708; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially
 supernatural):—sight, vision.

G3706.definition:
ὅρασις hórasis, hor'-as-is; from G3708; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or
 (internally) an inspired appearance:—sight, vision.

G3707.definition:
ὁρατός horatós, hor-at-os'; from G3708; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being
 seen:—visible.

G3708.definition:
†ὁράω horáō, hor-ah'-o; properly, to stare at (compare G3700), i.e. (by implication) to discern
 clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by
 Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:—behold, perceive, see,
 take heed.

G3709.definition:
ὀργή orgḗ, or-gay'; from G3713; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the
 mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable)
 abhorrence); by implication punishment:—anger, indignation,
 vengeance, wrath.

G371.definition: ἀναξίως anaxíōs, an-ax-ee'-oce; adverb from G370; irreverently:—unworthily.

G3710.definition:
ὀργίζω orgízō, or-gid'-zo; from G3709; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become
 exasperated:—be angry (wroth).

G3711.definition: ὀργίλος orgílos, org-ee'-los; from G3709; irascible:—soon angry.

G3712.definition: ὀργυιά orguiá, org-wee-ah'; from G3713; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:—fathom.

G3713.definition:
†ὀρέγομαι orégomai, or-eg'-om-ahee; middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary
 (compare G3735); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long
 for):—covet after, desire.

G3714.definition:
ὀρεινός oreinós, or-i-nos; from G3735; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of G5561) the
 Highlands (of Judæa):—hill country.

G3715.definition: ὄρεξις órexis, or'-ex-is; from G3713; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:—lust.

G3716.definition:
ὀρθοποδέω orthopodéō, or-thop-od-eh'-o; from a compound of G3717 and G4228; to be straight-footed, i.e.
 (figuratively) to go directly forward:—walk uprightly.

G3717.definition:
ὀρθός orthós, or-thos'; probably from the base of G3735; right (as rising), i.e.
 (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally)
 level or direct:—straight, upright.

G3718.definition:
ὀρθοτομέω orthotoméō, or-thot-om-eh'-o; from a compound of G3717 and the base of G5114, to make a straight cut,
 i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine
 message):—rightly divide.

G3719.definition:
ὀρθρίζω orthrízō, or-thrid'-zo; from G3722; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair
 betimes:—come early in the morning.

G372.definition: ἀνάπαυσις anápausis, an-ap'-ow-sis; from G373; intermission; by implication, recreation:—rest.

G3720.definition:
ὀρθρινός orthrinós, or-thrin-os'; from G3722; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of
 Venus, especially brilliant in the early day):—morning.

G3722.definition:
ὄρθρος órthros, or'-thros; from the same as G3735; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by
 extension, morn:—early in the morning.

G3723.definition:
ὀρθῶς orthōs, or-thoce'; adverb from G3717; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly
 (also morally):—plain, right(-ly).

G3724.definition:
ὁρίζω horízō, hor-id'-zo; from G3725; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to
 appoint, decree, specify:—declare, determine, limit, ordain.

G3725.definition:
ὅριον hórion, hor'-ee-on; neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary ὅρος hóros (a bound or
 limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier
 (region):—border, coast.

G3726.definition:
†ὁρκίζω horkízō, hor-kid'-zo; from G3727; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly
 enjoin:—adjure, charge.

G3727.definition:
ὅρκος hórkos, hor'-kos; from ἕρκος hérkos (a fence; perhaps akin to G3725); a limit, i.e. (sacred)
 restraint (specially, an oath):—oath.

G3728.definition:
ὁρκωμοσία horkōmosía, hor-ko-mos-ee'ah; from a compound of G3727 and a derivative of G3660; asseveration on
 oath:—oath.

G3729.definition:
ὁρμάω hormáō, hor-mah'-o; from G3730; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or
 plunge:—run (violently), rush.

G373.definition:
ἀναπαύω anapaúō, an-ap-ow'-o; from G303 and G3973; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively
 (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:—take ease, refresh,
 (give, take) rest.

G3730.definition: ὁρμή hormḗ, hor-may'; of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:—assault.

G3731.definition: ὅρμημα hórmēma, hor'-may-mah; from G3730; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy:—violence.

G3732.definition: ὄρνεον órneon, or'-neh-on; neuter of a presumed derivative of G3733; a birdling:—bird, fowl.

G3733.definition:
ὄρνις órnis, or'-nis; probably from a prolonged form of the base of G3735; a bird (as rising
 in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):—hen.

G3734.definition:
ὁροθεσία horothesía, hor-oth-es-ee'-ah; from a compound of the base of G3725 and a derivative of G5087; a
 limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line:—bound.

G3736.definition: ὀρύσσω orýssō, or-oos'-so; apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig:—dig.

G3737.definition:
ὀρφανός orphanós, or-fan-os'; of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e.
 parentless:—comfortless, fatherless.

G3738.definition:
ὀρχέομαι orchéomai, or-kheh'-om-ahee; middle voice from ὄρχος órchos (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike
 or regular motion):—dance.

G3739.definition:
ὅς hós, hos; probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article G3588); the
 relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what,
 that:—one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se),
 etc. See also G3757.

G374.definition: ἀναπείθω anapeíthō, an-ap-i'-tho; from G303 and G3982; to incite:—persuade.

G3740.definition:
ὁσάκις hosákis, hos-ak'-is; multiple adverb from G3739; how (i.e. with G302, so) many times as:—as
 oft(-en) as.

G3741.definition: ὅσιος hósios, hos'-ee-os; of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from G1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from G2413, which denotes formal consecration; and from G40, which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure):—holy, mercy, shalt be.

G3742.definition: ὁσιότης hosiótēs, hos-ee-ot'-ace; from G3741; piety:—holiness.

G3743.definition: ὁσίως hosíōs, hos-ee-oce'; adverb from G3741; piously:—holily.

G3744.definition: ὀσμή osmḗ, os-may'; from G3605; fragrance (literally or figuratively):—odour, savour.

G3745.definition:
ὅσος hósos, hos'-os; by reduplication from G3739; as (much, great, long, etc.) as:—all
 (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much),
 (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what
 (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, × while,
 who(-soever).

G3747.definition: ὀστέον ostéon, os-teh'-on; of uncertain affinity; a bone:—bone.

G3748.definition:
ὅστις hóstis, hos'-tis; from G3739 and G5100; which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which
 same:—X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they,
 what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever). Compare G3754.

G3749.definition:
ὀστράκινος ostrákinos, os-tra'-kin-os; from ὄστρακον óstrakon ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware,
 i.e. clayey; by implication, frail:—of earth, earthen.

G375.definition: ἀναπέμπω anapémpō, an-ap-em'-po; from G303 and G3992; to send up or back:—send (again).

G3750.definition: ὄσφρησις ósphrēsis, os'-fray-sis; from a derivative of G3605; smell (the sense):—smelling.

G3751.definition:
ὀσφῦς osphŷs, os-foos'; of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally
 (by extension) procreative power:—loin.

G3752.definition:
ὅταν hótan, hot'-an; from G3753 and G302; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less
 uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as:—as long
 (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.

G3753.definition:
ὅτε hóte, hot'-eh; from G3739 and G5037; at which (thing) too, i.e. when:—after (that), as
 soon as, that, when, while.

G3754.definition:
ὅτι hóti, hot'-ee; neuter of G3748 as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes
 redundant); causative, because:—as concerning that, as though,
 because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.

G3756.definition:
οὐ ou, oo; a primary word; the absolute negative (compare G3361) adverb; no or
 not:—+ long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, +
 nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but. See also
 G3364, G3372.

G3757.definition:
οὗ hoû, hoo; genitive case of G3739 as adverb; at which place, i.e.
 where:—where(-in), whither(-soever).

G3758.definition: οὐά ouá, oo-ah'; a primary exclamation of surprise; "ah":—ah.

G3759.definition: οὐαί ouaí, oo-ah'-ee; a primary exclamation of grief; "woe":—alas, woe.

G376.definition:
†ἀνάπηρος anápēros, an-ap'-ay-ros; from G303 (in the sense of intensity) and πῆρος pēros (maimed); 
 crippled:—maimed.

G3760.definition: οὐδαμῶς oudamōs, oo-dam-oce'; adverb from (the feminine) of G3762; by no means:—not.

G3761.definition:
οὐδέ oudé, oo-deh'; from G3756 and G1161; not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even:—neither
 (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then)
 not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.

G3762.definition:
†οὐδείς oudeís, oo-dice'; from G3761 and G1520; not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none,
 nobody, nothing:—any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never
 (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing),
 nought.

G3763.definition:
οὐδέποτε oudépote, oo-dep'-ot-eh; from G3761 and G4218; not even at any time, i.e. never at all:—neither
 at any time, never, nothing at any time.

G3764.definition:
οὐδέπω oudépō, oo-dep'-o; from G3761 and G4452; not even yet:—as yet not, never before (yet),
 (not) yet.

G3765.definition:
οὐκέτι oukéti, ook-et'-ee; from G3756 and G2089; not yet, no longer:—after that (not), (not) any
 more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now),
 now no more (not), yet (not).

G3766.definition:
οὐκοῦν oukoûn, ook-oon'; from G3756 and G3767; is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively)
 hence or so:—then.

G3767.definition:
οὖν oûn, oon; apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or
 (conjunctionally) accordingly:—and (so, truly), but, now (then), so
 (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.

G3768.definition: οὔπω oúpō, oo'-po; from G3756 and G4452; not yet:—hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet.

G3769.definition: οὐρά ourá, oo-rah'; apparently a primary word; a tail:—tail.

G377.definition:
ἀναπίπτω anapíptō, an-ap-ip'-to; from G303 and G4098; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:—lean, sit
 down (to meat).

G3770.definition:
οὐράνιος ouránios, oo-ran'-ee-os; from G3772; celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the
 sky:—heavenly.

G3771.definition: οὐρανόθεν ouranóthen, oo-ran-oth'-en; from G3772 and the enclitic of source; from the sky:—from heaven.

G3772.definition:
οὐρανός ouranós, oo-ran-os'; perhaps from the same as G3735 (through the idea of elevation); the
 sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication,
 happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel
 (Christianity):—air, heaven(-ly), sky.

G3773.definition:
Οὐρβανός Ourbanós, oor-ban-os'; of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a
 Christian:—Urbanus.

G3774.definition: Οὐρίας Ourías, oo-ree'-as; of Hebrew origin (H223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite:—Urias.

G3775.definition: οὖς oûs, ooce; apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally):—ear.

G3776.definition:
οὐσία ousía, oo-see'-ah; from the feminine of G5607; substance, i.e. property
 (possessions):—goods, substance.

G3777.definition:
οὔτε oúte, oo'-teh; from G3756 and G5037; not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not
 even:—neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.

G3778.definition:
οὗτος hoûtos, hoo'-tos; from the article G3588 and G846; the he (she or it), i.e. this or that
 (often with article repeated):—he (it was that), hereof, it, she,
 such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.

G3779.definition:
οὕτω hoútō, hoo'-to; adverb from G3778; in this way (referring to what precedes or
 follows):—after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all
 that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like
 manner), thus, what.

G3780.definition: οὐχί ouchí, oo-khee'; intensive of G3756; not indeed:—nay, not.

G3781.definition:
ὀφειλέτης opheilétēs, of-i-let'-ace; from G3784; an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent;
 morally, a transgressor (against God):—debtor, which owed, sinner.

G3782.definition:
ὀφειλή opheilḗ, of-i-lay'; from G3784; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively,
 obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty:—debt, due.

G3783.definition:
ὀφείλημα opheílēma, of-i'-lay-mah; from (the alternate of) G3784; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a
 due; morally, a fault:—debt.

G3784.definition:
ὀφείλω opheílō, of-i'-lo; probably from the base of G3786 (through the idea of accruing); to owe
 (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must,
 should); morally, to fail in duty:—behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or),
 (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe,
 should. See also G3785.

G3785.definition:
ὄφελον óphelon, of'-el-on; first person singular of a past tense of G3784; I ought (wish), i.e.
 (interjection) oh that!:—would (to God).

G3786.definition:
ὄφελος óphelos, of'-el-os; from ὀφέλλω ophéllō (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); 
 gain:—advantageth, profit.

G3787.definition:
†ὀφθαλμοδουλεία ophthalmodouleía, of-thal-mod-oo-li'-ah; from G3788 and G1397; sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching
 (remissness):—eye-service.

G3788.definition:
ὀφθαλμός ophthalmós, of-thal-mos'; from G3700; the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication,
 vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance):—eye,
 sight.

G3789.definition:
ὄφις óphis, of'-is; probably from G3700 (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake,
 figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person,
 especially Satan:—serpent.

G379.definition:
ἀναπολόγητος anapológētos, an-ap-ol-og'-ay-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626; 
 indefensible:—without an excuse, inexcusable.

G3790.definition:
ὀφρῦς ophrŷs, of-roos'; perhaps from G3700 (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the
 organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the
 brink of a precipice:—brow.

G3791.definition: ὀχλέω ochléō, okh-leh'-o; from G3793; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass:—vex.

G3792.definition:
ὀχλοποιέω ochlopoiéō, okh-lop-oy-eh'-o; from G3793 and G4160; to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public
 disturbance:—gather a company.

G3793.definition:
ὄχλος óchlos, okh'los; from a derivative of G2192 (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne
 along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people;
 figuratively, a riot:—company, multitude, number (of people), people,
 press.

G3794.definition:
ὀχύρωμα ochýrōma, okh-oo'-ro-mah; from a remote derivative of G2192 (meaning to fortify, through the idea
 of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument):—stronghold.

G3795.definition:
ὀψάριον opsárion, op-sar'-ee-on; neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G3702; a relish to other
 food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted
 and dried as a condiment):—fish.

G3797.definition: ὄψιμος ópsimos, op'-sim-os; from G3796; later, i.e. vernal (showering):—latter.

G3798.definition:
†ὄψιος ópsios, op'-see-os; from G3796; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall
 (later eve):—even(-ing, (-tide)).

G3799.definition:
ὄψις ópsis, op'-sis; from G3700; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the
 visage, an external show:—appearance, countenance, face.

G38.definition:
ἁγιασμός hagiasmós, hag-ee-as-mos'; from G37; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely
 (by Hebraism) a purifier:—holiness, sanctification.

G380.definition:
ἀναπτύσσω anaptýssō, an-ap-toos'-o; from G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G4428; to unroll (a scroll or
 volume):—open.

G3800.definition:
ὀψώνιον opsṓnion, op-so'-nee-on; neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795; rations for a
 soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay:—wages.

G3802.definition: παγιδεύω pagideúō, pag-id-yoo'-o; from G3803; to ensnare (figuratively):—entangle.

G3803.definition:
παγίς pagís, pag-ece'; from G4078; a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a
 trick or statagem (temptation):—snare.

G3804.definition:
πάθημα páthēma, path'-ay-mah; from a presumed derivative of G3806; something undergone, i.e. hardship
 or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence:—affection,
 affliction, motion, suffering.

G3805.definition:
παθητός pathētós, path-ay-tos'; from the same as G3804; liable (i.e. doomed) to experience
 pain:—suffer.

G3806.definition:
πάθος páthos, path'-os; from the alternate of G3958; properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e.
 (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence):—(inordinate)
 affection, lust.

G3807.definition:
παιδαγωγός paidagōgós, pahee-dag-o-gos'; from G3816 and a reduplicated form of G71; a boy-leader, i.e. a servant
 whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication,
 (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue")):—instructor, schoolmaster.

G3808.definition: παιδάριον paidárion, pahee-dar'-ee-on; neuter of a presumed derivative of G3816; a little boy:—child, lad.

G3809.definition:
παιδεία paideía, pahee-di'-ah; from G3811; tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication,
 disciplinary correction:—chastening, chastisement, instruction,
 nurture.

G381.definition: ἀνάπτω anáptō, an-ap'-to; from G303 and G681; to enkindle:—kindle, light.

G3810.definition:
παιδευτής paideutḗs, pahee-dyoo-tace'; from G3811; a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication)
 discipliner:—which corrected, instructor.

G3811.definition:
παιδεύω paideúō, pahee-dyoo'-o; from G3816; to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication),
 discipline (by punishment):—chasten(-ise), instruct, learn, teach.

G3812.definition: παιδιόθεν paidióthen, pahee-dee-oth'-en; adverb (of source) from G3813; from infancy:—of a child.

G3814.definition:
παιδίσκη paidískē, pahee-dis'-kay; feminine diminutive of G3816; a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave
 or servant:—bondmaid(-woman), damsel, maid(-en).

G3815.definition: παίζω paízō, paheed'-zo; from G3816; to sport (as a boy):—play.

G3816.definition:
παῖς paîs, paheece; perhaps from G3817; a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by
 analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or
 servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to
 God):—child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.

G3817.definition:
παίω paíō, pah'-yo; a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than
 G5180); specially, to sting (as a scorpion):—smite, strike.

G382.definition:
ἀναρίθμητος anaríthmētos, an-ar-ith'-may-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705; unnumbered,
 i.e. without number:—innumerable.

G3820.definition: παλαιός palaiós, pal-ah-yos'; from G3819; antique, i.e. not recent, worn out:—old.

G3821.definition: παλαιότης palaiótēs, pal-ah-yot'-ace; from G3820; antiquatedness:—oldness.

G3822.definition:
παλαιόω palaióō, pal-ah-yo'-o; from G3820; to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare
 obsolete:—decay, make (wax) old.

G3823.definition: πάλη pálē, pal'-ay; from πάλλω pállō (to vibrate; another form for G906); wrestling:—+ wrestle.

G3824.definition:
παλιγγενεσία palingenesía, pal-ing-ghen-es-ee'-ah; from G3825 and G1078; (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e.
 (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic
 restoration:—regeneration.

G3825.definition:
πάλιν pálin, pal'-in; probably from the same as G3823 (through the idea of oscillatory
 repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once
 more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand:—again.

G3826.definition:
παμπληθεί pamplētheí, pam-play-thi'; dative case (adverb) of a compound of G3956 and G4128; in full
 multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously:—all at once.

G3828.definition:
Παμφυλία Pamphylía, pam-fool-ee'-ah; from a compound of G3956 and G4443; every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous
 (G5561 being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor:—Pamphylia.

G383.definition: ἀνασείω anaseíō, an-as-i'-o; from G303 and G4579; figuratively, to excite:—move, stir up.

G3830.definition: πανδοχεύς pandocheús, pan-dokh-yoos'; from the same as G3829; an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai):—host.

G3831.definition:
πανήγυρις panḗgyris, pan-ay'-goo-ris; from G3956 and a derivative of G58; a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively)
 universal companionship:—general assembly.

G3832.definition: †πανοικί panoikí, pan-oy-kee'; adverb from G3956 and G3624; with the whole family:—with all his house.

G3833.definition:
πανοπλία panoplía, pan-op-lee'-ah; from a compound of G3956 and G3696; full armor ("panoply"):—all (whole)
 armour.

G3834.definition:
πανουργία panourgía, pan-oorg-ee'-ah; from G3835; adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or
 sophistry:—(cunning) craftiness, subtilty.

G3835.definition: πανοῦργος panoûrgos, pan-oor'-gos; from G3956 and G2041; all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd):—crafty.

G3837.definition:
†πανταχοῦ pantachoû, pan-takh-oo'; genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of G3956; 
 universally:—in all places, everywhere.

G3838.definition:
παντελής pantelḗs, pan-tel-ace'; from G3956 and G5056; full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun,
 completion):—+ in (no) wise, uttermost.

G3839.definition: †πάντη pántē, pan'-tay; adverb (of manner) from G3956; wholly:—always.

G3840.definition:
πάντοθεν pántothen, pan-toth'-en; adverb (of source) from G3956; from (i.e. on) all sides:—on every
 side, round about.

G3841.definition:
παντοκράτωρ pantokrátōr, pan-tok-rat'-ore; from G3956 and G2904; the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and
 universal sovereign):—Almighty, Omnipotent.

G3842.definition:
πάντοτε pántote, pan'-tot-eh; from G3956 and G3753; every when, i.e. at all times:—alway(-s),
 ever(-more).

G3843.definition:
πάντως pántōs, pan'-toce; adverb from G3956; entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative,
 following) in no event:—by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no
 doubt, in (no) wise, surely.

G3844.definition:
παρά pará, par-ah'; a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from
 beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the
 vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to
 the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal
 (on account of):—above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to,
 × friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had,
 × his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save,
 side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with.

G3845.definition:
παραβαίνω parabaínō, par-ab-ah'-ee-no; from G3844 and the base of G939; to go contrary to, i.e. violate a
 command:—(by) transgress(-ion).

G3846.definition:
παραβάλλω parabállō, par-ab-al'-lo; from G3844 and G906; to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a
 place, or (figuratively) to liken:—arrive, compare.

G3847.definition: παράβασις parábasis, par-ab'-as-is; from G3845; violation:—breaking, transgression.

G3848.definition: παραβάτης parabátēs, par-ab-at'-ace; from G3845; a violator:—breaker, transgress(-or).

G3849.definition:
παραβιάζομαι parabiázomai, par-ab-ee-ad'-zom-ahee; from G3844 and the middle voice of G971; to force contrary to (nature),
 i.e. compel (by entreaty):—constrain.

G385.definition: ἀνασπάω anaspáō, an-as-pah'-o; from G303 and G4685; to take up or extricate:—draw up, pull out.

G3850.definition:
παραβολή parabolḗ, par-ab-ol-ay'; from G3846; a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious
 narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or
 adage:—comparison, figure, parable, proverb.

G3852.definition: παραγγελία parangelía, par-ang-gel-ee'-ah; from G3853; a mandate:—charge, command.

G3853.definition:
παραγγέλλω parangéllō, par-ang-gel'-lo; from G3844 and the base of G32; to transmit a message, i.e. (by
 implication) to enjoin:—(give in) charge, (give) command(-ment),
 declare.

G3854.definition:
παραγίνομαι paragínomai, par-ag-in'-om-ahee; from G3844 and G1096; to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by
 implication, to appear publicly:—come, go, be present.

G3855.definition:
παράγω parágō, par-ag'-o; from G3844 and G71; to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively)
 to go along or away:—depart, pass (away, by, forth).

G3856.definition:
παραδειγματίζω paradeigmatízō, par-ad-igue-mat-id'-zo; from G3844 and G1165; to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to
 infamy:—make a public example, put to an open shame.

G3857.definition:
παράδεισος parádeisos, par-ad'-i-sos; of Oriental origin (compare H6508); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden
 (place of future happiness, "paradise"):—paradise.

G3858.definition:
παραδέχομαι paradéchomai, par-ad-ekh'-om-ahee; from G3844 and G1209; to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication)
 delight in:—receive.

G386.definition:
ἀνάστασις anástasis, an-as'-tas-is; from G450; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from
 death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or
 (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth):—raised to
 life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising
 again.

G3860.definition:
παραδίδωμι paradídōmi, par-ad-id'-o-mee; from G3844 and G1325; to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust,
 transmit:—betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give
 (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.

G3861.definition:
παράδοξος parádoxos, par-ad'-ox-os; from G3844 and G1391 (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation,
 i.e. extraordinary ("paradox"):—strange.

G3862.definition:
παράδοσις parádosis, par-ad'-os-is; from G3860; transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the
 Jewish traditionary law:—ordinance, tradition.

G3863.definition:
παραζηλόω parazēlóō, par-ad-zay-lo'-o; from G3844 and G2206; to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to
 rivalry:—provoke to emulation (jealousy).

G3864.definition:
παραθαλάσσιος parathalássios, par-ath-al-as'-see-os; from G3844 and G2281; along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine):—upon
 the sea coast.

G3865.definition: παραθεωρέω paratheōréō, par-ath-eh-o-reh'-o; from G3844 and G2334; to overlook or disregard:—neglect.

G3866.definition: παραθήκη parathḗkē, par-ath-ay'-kay; from G3908; a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust:—committed unto.

G3867.definition:
παραινέω parainéō, par-ahee-neh'-o; from G3844 and G134; to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different
 course):—admonish, exhort.

G3868.definition:
παραιτέομαι paraitéomai, par-ahee-teh'-om-ahee; from G3844 and the middle voice of G154; to beg off, i.e. deprecate,
 decline, shun:—avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject.

G3869.definition: †παρακαθίζω parakathízō, par-ak-ath-id'-zo; from G3844 and G2523; to sit down near:—sit.

G387.definition:
ἀναστατόω anastatóō, an-as-tat-o'-o; from a derivative of G450 (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive
 out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or
 figuratively):—trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.

G3870.definition:
παρακαλέω parakaléō, par-ak-al-eh'-o; from G3844 and G2564; to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration,
 hortation or consolation):—beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort,
 desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray.

G3871.definition:
παρακαλύπτω parakalýptō, par-ak-al-oop'-to; from G3844 and G2572; to cover alongside, i.e. veil
 (figuratively):—hide.

G3873.definition:
παράκειμαι parákeimai, par-ak'-i-mahee; from G3844 and G2749; to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be
 prompt or easy):—be present.

G3874.definition:
παράκλησις paráklēsis, par-ak'-lay-sis; from G3870; imploration, hortation, solace:—comfort, consolation,
 exhortation, intreaty.

G3875.definition: παράκλητος paráklētos, par-ak'-lay-tos; an intercessor, consoler:—advocate, comforter.

G3876.definition:
παρακοή parakoḗ, par-ak-o-ay'; from G3878; inattention, i.e. (by implication)
 disobedience:—disobedience.

G3877.definition:
παρακολουθέω parakolouthéō, par-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o; from G3844 and G190; to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a
 result), trace out, conform to:—attain, follow, fully know, have
 understanding.

G3878.definition:
παρακούω parakoúō, par-ak-oo'-o; from G3844 and G191; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to
 disobey:—neglect to hear.

G3879.definition:
παρακύπτω parakýptō, par-ak-oop'-to; from G3844 and G2955; to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer
 within):—look (into), stoop down.

G388.definition: ἀνασταυρόω anastauróō, an-as-tow-ro'-o; from G303 and G4717; to recrucify (figuratively):—crucify afresh.

G3880.definition:
παραλαμβάνω paralambánō, par-al-am-ban'-o; from G3844 and G2983; to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in
 any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an
 office; figuratively, to learn:—receive, take (unto, with).

G3881.definition:
παραλέγομαι paralégomai, par-al-eg'-om-ahee; from G3844 and the middle voice of G3004 (in its original sense); 
 (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past:—pass, sail by.

G3882.definition: παράλιος parálios, par-al'-ee-os; from G3844 and G251; beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime:—sea coast.

G3883.definition:
παραλλαγή parallagḗ, par-al-lag-ay'; from a compound of G3844 and G236; transmutation (of phase or orbit),
 i.e. (figuratively) fickleness:—variableness.

G3884.definition: παραλογίζομαι paralogízomai, par-al-og-id'-zom-ahee; from G3844 and G3049; to misreckon, i.e. delude:—beguile, deceive.

G3885.definition:
παραλυτικός paralytikós, par-al-oo-tee-kos'; from a derivative of G3886; as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic":—that
 had (sick of) the palsy.

G3886.definition:
παραλύω paralýō, par-al-oo'-o; from G3844 and G3089; to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive
 participle, paralyzed or enfeebled):—feeble, sick of the (taken with)
 palsy.

G3887.definition:
παραμένω paraménō, par-am-en'-o; from G3844 and G3306; to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or
 figuratively, be permanent, persevere):—abide, continue.

G3888.definition:
παραμυθέομαι paramythéomai, par-am-oo-theh'-om-ahee; from G3844 and the middle voice of a derivative of G3454; to relate
 near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console:—comfort.

G3889.definition: παραμυθία paramythía, par-am-oo-thee'-ah; from G3888; consolation (properly, abstract):—comfort.

G389.definition: ἀναστενάζω anastenázō, an-as-ten-ad'-zo; from G303 and G4727; to sigh deeply:—sigh deeply.

G3890.definition: παραμύθιον paramýthion, par-am-oo'-thee-on; neuter of G3889; consolation (properly, concretely):—comfort.

G3891.definition:
παρανομέω paranoméō, par-an-om-eh'-o; from a compound of G3844 and G3551; to be opposed to law, i.e. to
 transgress:—contrary to law.

G3892.definition: παρανομία paranomía, par-an-om-ee'-ah; from the same as G3891; transgression:—iniquity.

G3893.definition:
παραπικραίνω parapikraínō, par-ap-ik-rah'-ee-no; from G3844 and G4087; to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to
 exasperate:—provoke.

G3894.definition: παραπικρασμός parapikrasmós, par-ap-ik-ras-mos'; from G3893; irritation:—provocation.

G3895.definition:
παραπίπτω parapíptō, par-ap-ip'-to; from G3844 and G4098; to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to
 apostatize:—fall away.

G3896.definition: παραπλέω parapléō, par-ap-leh'-o; from G3844 and G4126; to sail near:—sail by.

G3897.definition:
†παραπλήσιον paraplḗsion, par-ap-lay'-see-on; neuter of a compound of G3844 and the base of G4139 (as adverb); close
 by, i.e. (figuratively) almost:—nigh unto.

G3898.definition:
παραπλησίως paraplēsíōs, par-ap-lay-see'-oce; adverb from the same as G3897; in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively)
 similarly:—likewise.

G3899.definition: παραπορεύομαι paraporeúomai, par-ap-or-yoo'-om-ahee; from G3844 and G4198; to travel near:—go, pass (by).

G390.definition:
ἀναστρέφω anastréphō, an-as-tref'-o; from G303 and G4762; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to
 busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:—abide, behave self, have
 conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

G3900.definition:
παράπτωμα paráptōma, par-ap'-to-mah; from G3895; a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional)
 error or (wilful) transgression:—fall, fault, offence, sin, trespass.

G3901.definition:
†παραῤῥυέω pararrhyéō, par-ar-hroo-eh'-o; from G3844 and the alternate of G4482; to flow by, i.e. (figuratively)
 carelessly pass (miss):—let slip.

G3902.definition:
†παράσημος parásēmos, par-as'-ay-mos; from G3844 and the base of G4591; side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a
 badge (figure-head) of a ship):—sign.

G3903.definition:
παρασκευάζω paraskeuázō, par-ask-yoo-ad'-zo; from G3844 and a derivative of G4632; to furnish aside, i.e. get
 ready:—prepare self, be (make) ready.

G3904.definition: παρασκευή paraskeuḗ, par-ask-yoo-ay'; as if from G3903; readiness:—preparation.

G3905.definition:
παρατείνω parateínō, par-at-i'-no; from G3844 and teino (to stretch); to extend along, i.e. prolong (in
 point of time):—continue.

G3906.definition:
παρατηρέω paratēréō, par-at-ay-reh'-o; from G3844 and G5083; to inspect alongside, i.e. note insidiously or
 scrupulously:—observe, watch.

G3907.definition: παρατήρησις paratḗrēsis, par-at-ay'-ray-sis; from G3906; inspection, i.e. ocular evidence:—obervation.

G3908.definition:
παρατίθημι paratíthēmi, par-at-ith'-ay-mee; from G3844 and G5087; to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by
 implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection):—allege,
 commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.

G3909.definition: παρατυγχάνω paratynchánō, par-at-oong-khan'-o; from G3844 and G5177; to chance near, i.e. fall in with:—meet with.

G391.definition: ἀναστροφή anastrophḗ, an-as-trof-ay'; from G390; behavior:—conversation.

G3910.definition:
παραυτίκα parautíka, par-ow-tee'-kah; from G3844 and a derivative of G846; at the very instant, i.e.
 momentary:—but for a moment.

G3911.definition:
παραφέρω paraphérō, par-af-er'-o; from G3844 and G5342 (including its alternate forms); to bear along or
 aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to
 avert:—remove, take away.

G3912.definition: παραφρονέω paraphronéō, par-af-ron-eh'-o; from G3844 and G5426; to misthink, i.e. be insane (silly):—as a fool.

G3913.definition: παραφρονία paraphronía, par-af-ron-ee'-ah; from G3912; insanity, i.e. foolhardiness:—madness.

G3914.definition:
παραχειμάζω paracheimázō, par-akh-i-mad'-zo; from G3844 and G5492; to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy
 season:—winter.

G3915.definition: παραχειμασία paracheimasía, par-akh-i-mas-ee'-ah; from G3914; a wintering over:—winter in.

G3916.definition:
παραχρῆμα parachrēma, par-akh-ray'-mah; from G3844 and G5536 (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e.
 instantly:—forthwith, immediately, presently, straightway, soon.

G3917.definition: πάρδαλις párdalis, par'-dal-is; feminine of πάρδος párdos (a panther); a leopard:—leopard.

G3918.definition:
πάρειμι páreimi, par'-i-mee; from G3844 and G1510 (including its various forms); to be near, i.e. at
 hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural)
 property:—come, × have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.

G3919.definition:
παρεισάγω pareiságō, par-ice-ag'-o; from G3844 and G1521; to lead in aside, i.e. introduce
 surreptitiously:—privily bring in.

G392.definition: ἀνατάσσομαι anatássomai, an-at-as'-som-ahee; from G303 and the middle voice of G5021; to arrange:—set in order.

G3920.definition: παρείσακτος pareísaktos, par-ice'-ak-tos; from G3919; smuggled in:—unawares brought in.

G3921.definition:
†παρεισδύνω pareisdýnō, par-ice-doo'-no; from G3844 and a compound of G1519 and G1416; to settle in alongside,
 i.e. lodge stealthily:—creep in unawares.

G3922.definition:
παρεισέρχομαι pareisérchomai, par-ice-er'-khom-ahee; from G3844 and G1525; to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally
 or steathily:—come in privily, enter.

G3923.definition:
παρεισφέρω pareisphérō, par-ice-fer'-o; from G3844 and G1533; to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce
 simultaneously:—give.

G3924.definition:
παρεκτός parektós, par-ek-tos'; from G3844 and G1622; near outside, i.e. besides:—except, saving,
 without.

G3925.definition:
παρεμβολή parembolḗ, par-em-bol-ay'; from a compound of G3844 and G1685; a throwing in beside
 (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or
 barracks (tower Antonia):—army, camp, castle.

G3926.definition: παρενοχλέω parenochléō, par-en-okh-leh'-o; from G3844 and G1776; to harass further, i.e. annoy:—trouble.

G3927.definition:
παρεπίδημος parepídēmos, par-ep-id'-ay-mos; from G3844 and the base of G1927; an alien alongside, i.e. a resident
 foreigner:—pilgrim, stranger.

G3928.definition:
παρέρχομαι parérchomai, par-er'-khom-ahee; from G3844 and G2064; to come near or aside, i.e. to approach (arrive),
 go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative)
 avert:—come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.

G3929.definition: πάρεσις páresis, par'-es-is; from G2935; praetermission, i.e. toleration:—remission.

G393.definition:
ἀνατέλλω anatéllō, an-at-el'-lo; from G303 and the base of G5056; to (cause to) arise:—(a-, make to)
 rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

G3930.definition:
παρέχω paréchō, par-ekh'-o; from G3844 and G2192; to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit,
 furnish occasion:—bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, +
 trouble.

G3931.definition:
παρηγορία parēgoría, par-ay-gor-ee'-ah; from a compound of G3844 and a derivative of G58 (meaning to harangue an
 assembly); an address alongside, i.e. (specially),
 consolation:—comfort.

G3932.definition: παρθενία parthenía, par-then-ee'-ah; from G3933; maidenhood:—virginity.

G3933.definition:
παρθένος parthénos, par-then'-os; of unknown origin; a maiden; by implication, an unmarried
 daughter:—virgin.

G3934.definition:
Πάρθος Párthos, par'-thos; probably of foreign origin; a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of
 Parthia:—Parthian.

G3935.definition: παρίημι paríēmi, par-ee'-ay-mi; from G3844 and hiemi (to send); to let by, i.e. relax:—hang down.

G3936.definition:
παρίστημι parístēmi, par-is'-tay-mee; from G3844 and G2476; to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit,
 proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or
 (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid:—assist, bring before,
 command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand
 (before, by, here, up, with), yield.

G3937.definition:
Παρμενᾶς Parmenâs, par-men-as'; probably by contraction for Παρμενίδης Parmenídēs (a derivative of a compound of
 G3844 and G3306); constant; Parmenas, a Christian:—Parmenas.

G3938.definition: πάροδος párodos, par'-od-os; from G3844 and G3598; a by-road, i.e. (actively) a route:—way.

G3939.definition:
παροικέω paroikéō, par-oy-keh'-o; from G3844 and G3611; to dwell near, i.e. reside as a
 foreigner:—sojourn in, be a stranger.

G394.definition:
†ἀνατίθεμαι anatíthemai, an-at-ith'-em-ahee; from G303 and the middle voice of G5087; to set forth (for oneself), i.e
 propound:—communicate, declare.

G3940.definition: παροικία paroikía, par-oy-kee'-ah; from G3941; foreign residence:—sojourning, × as strangers.

G3941.definition:
πάροικος pároikos, par'-oy-kos; from G3844 and G3624; having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller
 (alien resident):—foreigner, sojourn, stranger.

G3942.definition:
παροιμία paroimía, par-oy-mee'-ah; from a compound of G3844 and perhaps a derivative of G3633; apparently a
 state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially,
 an enigmatical or fictitious illustration:—parable, proverb.

G3943.definition:
πάροινος pároinos, par'-oy-nos; from G3844 and G3631; staying near wine, i.e. tippling (a toper):—given
 to wine.

G3944.definition:
παροίχομαι paroíchomai, par-oy'-khom-ahee; from G3844 and οἴχομαι oíchomai (to depart); to escape along, i.e. be
 gone:—past.

G3945.definition: παρομοιάζω paromoiázō, par-om-oy-ad'-zo; from G3946; to resemble:—be like unto.

G3946.definition: παρόμοιος parómoios, par-om'-oy-os; from G3844 and G3664; alike nearly, i.e. similar:—like.

G3947.definition:
παροξύνω paroxýnō, par-ox-oo'-no; from G3844 and a derivative of G3691; to sharpen alongside, i.e.
 (figuratively) to exasperate:—easily provoke, stir.

G3948.definition:
παροξυσμός paroxysmós, par-ox-oos-mos'; from G3947 ("paroxysm"); incitement (to good), or dispute (in
 anger):—contention, provoke unto.

G3949.definition:
παροργίζω parorgízō, par-org-id'-zo; from G3844 and G3710; to anger alongside, i.e. enrage:—anger, provoke
 to wrath.

G395.definition:
ἀνατολή anatolḗ, an-at-ol-ay'; from G393; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication,
 the east (also in plural):—dayspring, east, rising.

G3950.definition: παροργισμός parorgismós, par-org-is-mos'; from G3949; rage:—wrath.

G3951.definition:
παροτρύνω parotrýnō, par-ot-roo'-no; from G3844 and ὀτρύνω otrýnō (to spur); to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to
 hostility):—stir up.

G3952.definition:
παρουσία parousía, par-oo-see'-ah; from the present participle of G3918; a being near, i.e. advent (often,
 return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the
 wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect:—coming, presence.

G3953.definition:
παροψίς paropsís, par-op-sis'; from G3844 and the base of G3795; a side-dish (the
 receptacle):—platter.

G3954.definition:
παῤῥησία parrhēsía, par-rhay-see'-ah; from G3956 and a derivative of G4483; all out-spokenness, i.e.
 frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance:—bold (X
 -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence,
 × freely, × openly, × plainly(-ness).

G3955.definition:
παῤῥησιάζομαι parrhēsiázomai, par-hray-see-ad'-zom-ahee; middle voice from G3954; to be frank in utterance, or confident in
 spirit and demeanor:—be (wax) bold, (preach, speak) boldly.

G3956.definition:
πᾶς pâs, pas; including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word; all,
 any, every, the whole:—all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one),
 × daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), X
 thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever.

G3957.definition:
πάσχα páscha, pas'-khah; of Chaldee origin (compare H6453); the Passover (the meal, the day, the
 festival or the special sacrifices connected with it):—Easter,
 Passover.

G3958.definition:
πάσχω páschō, pas'-kho; apparently a primary verb; to experience a sensation or impression
 (usually painful):—feel, passion, suffer, vex.

G3959.definition: Πάταρα Pátara, pat'-ar-ah; probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor:—Patara.

G396.definition:
ἀνατρέπω anatrépō, an-at-rep'-o; from G303 and the base of G5157; to overturn (figuratively):—overthrow,
 subvert.

G3960.definition:
πατάσσω patássō, pat-as'-so; probably prolongation from G3817; to knock (gently or with a weapon or
 fatally):—smite, strike. Compare G5180.

G3961.definition:
πατέω patéō, pat-eh'-o; from a derivative probably of G3817 (meaning a "path"); to trample
 (literally or figuratively):—tread (down, under foot).

G3962.definition:
†πατήρ patḗr, pat-ayr'; apparently a primary word; a "father" (literally or figuratively, near
 or more remote):—father, parent.

G3963.definition:
Πάτμος Pátmos, pat'-mos; of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the
 Mediterranean:—Patmos.

G3965.definition:
πατριά patriá, pat-ree-ah'; as if feminine of a derivative of G3962; paternal descent, i.e.
 (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation):—family,
 kindred, lineage.

G3966.definition: πατριάρχης patriárchēs, pat-ree-arkh'-ace; from G3965 and G757; a progenitor ("patriarch"):—patriarch.

G3967.definition: πατρικός patrikós, pat-ree-kos'; from G3962; paternal, i.e. ancestral:—of fathers.

G3968.definition:
πατρίς patrís, pat-rece'; from G3902; a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly
 home:—(own) country.

G3969.definition:
†Πατροβᾶς Patrobâs, pat-rob'-as; perhaps a contraction for Πατρόβιος Patróbios (a compound of G3962 and G979); 
 father's life; Patrobas, a Christian:—Patrobas.

G397.definition:
ἀνατρέφω anatréphō, an-at-ref'-o; from G303 and G5142; to rear (physically or mentally):—bring up,
 nourish (up).

G3970.definition:
πατροπαράδοτος patroparádotos, pat-rop-ar-ad'-ot-os; from G3962 and a derivative of G3860 (in the sense of handing over or
 down); traditionary:—received by tradition from fathers.

G3971.definition: πατρῷος patrōios, pat-ro'-os; from G3962; paternal, i.e. hereditary:—of fathers.

G3972.definition:
Παῦλος Paûlos, pow'-los; of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of G3973,
 meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an
 apostle:—Paul, Paulus.

G3973.definition:
παύω paúō, pow'-o; a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively),
 i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end:—cease, leave, refrain.

G3974.definition: Πάφος Páphos, paf'-os; of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:—Paphos.

G3975.definition:
παχύνω pachýnō, pakh-oo'-no; from a derivative of G4078 (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by
 implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous):—wax
 gross.

G3976.definition: πέδη pédē, ped'-ay; ultimately from G4228; a shackle for the feet:—fetter.

G3977.definition:
πεδινός pedinós, ped-ee-nos'; from a derivative of G4228 (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the
 feet):—plain.

G3978.definition:
πεζεύω pezeúō, ped-zyoo'-o; from the same as G3979; to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land:—go
 afoot.

G3979.definition:
πεζῇ pezēi, ped-zay'; dative case feminine of a derivative of G4228 (as adverb); foot-wise,
 i.e. by walking:—a- (on) foot.

G398.definition:
ἀναφαίνω anaphaínō, an-af-ah'-ee-no; from G303 and G5316; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively)
 to have pointed out:—(should) appear, discover.

G3980.definition:
πειθαρχέω peitharchéō, pi-tharkh-eh'-o; from a compound of G3982 and G757; to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e.
 (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to
 advice:—hearken, obey (magistrates).

G3982.definition:
πείθω peíthō, pi'-tho; a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy,
 to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or
 passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward
 certainty):—agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax)
 conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

G3983.definition:
πεινάω peináō, pi-nah'-o; from the same as G3993 (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to
 famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave:—be an
 hungered.

G3984.definition:
πεῖρα peîra, pi'-rah; from the base of G4008 (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e.
 attempt, experience:—assaying, trial.

G3985.definition:
πειράζω peirázō, pi-rad'-zo; from G3984; to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice,
 discipline:—assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

G3986.definition:
πειρασμός peirasmós, pi-ras-mos'; from G3985; a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of
 evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication,
 adversity:—temptation, × try.

G3987.definition:
†πειράω peiráō, pi-rah'-o; from G3984; to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to
 attempt:—assay.

G3988.definition:
πεισμονή peismonḗ, pice-mon-ay'; from a presumed derivative of G3982; persuadableness, i.e.
 credulity:—persuasion.

G3989.definition: πέλαγος pélagos, pel'-ag-os; of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:—depth, sea.

G399.definition:
ἀναφέρω anaphérō, an-af-er'-o; from G303 and G5342; to take up (literally or figuratively):—bear,
 bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).

G3990.definition:
πελεκίζω pelekízō, pel-ek-id'-zo; from a derivative of G4141 (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head),
 i.e. truncate:—behead.

G3991.definition: πέμπτος pémptos, pemp'-tos; from G4002; fifth:—fifth.

G3992.definition:
πέμπω pémpō, pem'-po; apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or
 point of departure, whereas ἵημι híēmi (as a stronger form of εἶμι eîmi) refers
 rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and G4724 denotes
 properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary
 errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield:—send, thrust in.

G3993.definition:
πένης pénēs, pen'-ace; from a primary πένω pénō (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e.
 indigent:—poor. Compare G4434.

G3994.definition: πενθερά pentherá, pen-ther-ah'; feminine of G3995; a wife's mother:—mother in law, wife's mother.

G3995.definition: πενθερός pentherós, pen-ther-os'; of uncertain affinity; a wife's father:—father in law.

G3996.definition: πενθέω penthéō, pen-theh'-o; from G3997; to grieve (the feeling or the act):—mourn, (be-)wail.

G3997.definition: πένθος pénthos, pen'-thos; strengthened from the alternate of G3958; grief:—mourning, sorrow.

G3998.definition: †πενιχρός penichrós, pen-tikh-ros'; prolongation from the base of G3993; necessitous:—poor.

G3999.definition: πεντάκις pentákis, pen-tak-ece'; multiplicative adverb from G4002; five times:—five times.

G4.definition:
ἀβαρής abarḗs, ab-ar-ace'; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G922; weightless, i.e.
 (figuratively) not burdensome:—from being burdensome.

G40.definition:
ἅγιος hágios, hag'-ee-os; from ἅγος hágos (an awful thing) (compare G53, G2282); sacred (physically,
 pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially,
 consecrated):—(most) holy (one, thing), saint.

G400.definition: ἀναφωνέω anaphōnéō, an-af-o-neh'-o; from G303 and G5455; to exclaim:—speak out.

G4000.definition: πεντακισχίλιοι pentakischílioi, pen-tak-is-khil'-ee-oy; from G3999 and G5507; five times a thousand:—five thousand.

G4001.definition: πεντακόσιοι pentakósioi, pen-tak-os'-ee-oy; from G4002 and G1540; five hundred:—five hundred.

G4002.definition: πέντε pénte, pen'-teh; a primary number; "five":—five.

G4003.definition: πεντεκαιδέκατος pentekaidékatos, pen-tek-ahee-dek'-at-os; from G4002 and G2532 and G1182; five and tenth:—fifteenth.

G4004.definition: †πεντήκοντα pentḗkonta, pen-tay'-kon-tah; multiplicative of G4002; fifty:—fifty.

G4005.definition:
πεντηκοστή pentēkostḗ, pen-tay-kos-tay'; feminine of the ordinal of G4004; fiftieth (G2250 being implied) from
 Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost":—Pentecost.

G4006.definition:
πεποίθησις pepoíthēsis, pep-oy'-thay-sis; from the perfect of the alternate of G3958; reliance:—confidence,
 trust.

G4007.definition:
περ per, per; from the base of G4008; an enclitic particle significant of abundance
 (thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever:—(whom-)soever.

G4008.definition:
†πέραν péran, per'-an; apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of πείρω peírō (to
 "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:—beyond,
 farther (other) side, over.

G4009.definition: πέρας péras, per'-as; from the same as G4008; an extremity:—end, ut-(ter-)most participle

G401.definition:
ἀνάχυσις anáchysis, an-akh'-oo-sis; from a comparative of G303 and χέω chéō (to pour); properly, effusion, i.e.
 (figuratively) license:—excess.

G4010.definition: Πέργαμος Pérgamos, per'-gam-os; from G4444; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:—Pergamos.

G4011.definition:
Πέργη Pérgē, perg'-ay; probably from the same as G4010; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia
 Minor:—Perga.

G4012.definition:
περί perí, per-ee'; from the base of G4008; properly, through (all over), i.e. around;
 figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place,
 cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion
 or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit,
 matter, circumstance or general period):—(there-)about, above,
 against, at, on behalf of, × and his company, which concern, (as)
 concerning, for, × how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on,
 over, pertaining (to), for sake, × (e-)state, (as) touching,
 (where-)by (in), with. In comparative, it retains substantially the
 same meaning of circuit (around), excess (beyond), or completeness
 (through).

G4013.definition:
περιάγω periágō, per-ee-ag'-o; from G4012 and G71; to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to
 walk around:—compass, go (round) about, lead about.

G4014.definition:
περιαιρέω periairéō, per-ee-ahee-reh'-o; from G4012 and G138 (including its alternate); to remove all around,
 i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate:—take away
 (up).

G4015.definition:
περιαστράπτω periastráptō, per-ee-as-trap'-to; from G4012 and G797; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:—shine
 round (about).

G4016.definition:
†περιβάλλω peribállō, per-ee-bal'-lo; from G4012 and G906; to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade
 or with clothing):—array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

G4017.definition: †περιβλέπω periblépō, per-ee-blep'-o; from G4012 and G991; to look all around:—look (round) about (on).

G4018.definition:
περιβόλαιον peribólaion, per-ib-ol'-ah-yon; neuter of a presumed derivative of G4016; something thrown around one,
 i.e. a mantle, veil:—covering, vesture.

G4019.definition:
περιδέω peridéō, per-ee-deh'-o; from G4012 and G1210; to bind around one, i.e. enwrap:—bind
 about.

G402.definition:
ἀναχωρέω anachōréō, an-akh-o-reh'-o; from G303 and G5562; to retire:—depart, give place, go (turn) aside,
 withdraw self.

G4020.definition:
περιεργάζομαι periergázomai, per-ee-er-gad'-zom-ahee; from G4012 and G2038; to work all around, i.e. bustle about
 (meddle):—be a busybody.

G4021.definition:
περίεργος períergos, per-ee'-er-gos; from G4012 and G2041; working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome,
 neuter plural magic):—busybody, curious arts.

G4022.definition:
περιέρχομαι periérchomai, per-ee-er'-khom-ahee; from G4012 and G2064 (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e.
 stroll, vacillate, veer:—fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

G4023.definition:
περιέχω periéchō, per-ee-ekh'-o; from G4012 and G2192; to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp
 (figuratively):—+ astonished, contain, after (this manner).

G4024.definition:
περιζώννυμι perizṓnnymi, per-id-zone'-noo-mee; from G4012 and G2224; to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive)
 to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively):—gird (about,
 self).

G4025.definition:
περίθεσις períthesis, per-ith'-es-is; from G4060; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself
 with:—wearing.

G4026.definition:
περιΐστημι periḯstēmi, per-ee-is'-tay-mee; from G4012 and G2476; to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a
 bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from:—avoid, shun, stand by (round
 about).

G4027.definition:
περικάθαρμα perikátharma, per-ee-kath'-ar-mah; from a compound of G4012 and G2508; something cleaned off all around,
 i.e. refuse (figuratively):—filth.

G4028.definition:
περικαλύπτω perikalýptō, per-ee-kal-oop'-to; from G4012 and G2572; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a
 surface):—blindfold, cover, overlay.

G4029.definition:
περίκειμαι períkeimai, per-ik'-i-mahee; from G4012 and G2749; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper
 (literally or figuratively):—be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

G403.definition:
ἀνάψυξις anápsyxis, an-aps'-ook-sis; from G404; properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively)
 revival:—revival.

G4030.definition:
περικεφαλαία perikephalaía, per-ee-kef-al-ah'-yah; feminine of a compound of G4012 and G2776; encirclement of the head,
 i.e. a helmet:—helmet.

G4031.definition:
περικρατής perikratḗs, per-ee-krat-ace'; from G4012 and G2904; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):—+
 come by.

G4032.definition: περικρύπτω perikrýptō, per-ee-kroop'-to; from G4012 and G2928; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:—hide.

G4033.definition:
περικυκλόω perikyklóō, per-ee-koo-klo'-o; from G4012 and G2944; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade
 completely:—compass round.

G4034.definition:
περιλάμπω perilámpō, per-ee-lam'-po; from G4012 and G2989; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a
 halo:—shine round about.

G4035.definition:
περιλείπω perileípō, per-ee-li'-po; from G4012 and G3007; to leave all around, i.e. (passively)
 survive:—remain.

G4036.definition:
περίλυπος perílypos, per-il'-oo-pos; from G4012 and G3077; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:—exceeding
 (very) sorry(-owful).

G4037.definition: περιμένω periménō, per-ee-men'-o; from G4012 and G3306; to stay around, i.e. await:—wait for.

G4038.definition:
πέριξ périx, per'-ix; adverb from G4012; all around, i.e. (as an adjective)
 circumjacent:—round about.

G4039.definition:
περιοικέω perioikéō, per-ee-oy-keh'-o; from G4012 and G3611; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:—dwell round
 about.

G404.definition:
ἀναψύχω anapsýchō, an-aps-oo'-kho; from G303 and G5594; properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively)
 relieve:—refresh.

G4040.definition:
περίοικος períoikos, per-ee'-oy-kos; from G4012 and G3624; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically
 as a noun):—neighbour.

G4041.definition: περιούσιος perioúsios, per-ee-oo'-see-os; from the present participle feminine of a compound of G4012 and G1510; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):—peculiar.

G4042.definition:
περιοχή periochḗ, per-ee-okh-ay'; from G4023; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of
 Scripture, as circumscribed):—place.

G4043.definition:
περιπατέω peripatéō, per-ee-pat-eh'-o; from G4012 and G3961; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large
 (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport
 oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):—go, be occupied with,
 walk (about).

G4044.definition:
περιπείρω peripeírō, per-ee-pi'-ro; from G4012 and the base of G4008; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix
 (figuratively):—pierce through.

G4045.definition:
περιπίπτω peripíptō, per-ee-pip'-to; from G4012 and G4098; to fall into something that is all around, i.e.
 light among or upon, be surrounded with:—fall among (into).

G4046.definition:
†περιποιέομαι peripoiéomai, per-ee-poy-eh'-om-ahee; middle voice from G4012 and G4160; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire
 (buy):—purchase.

G4047.definition:
περιποίησις peripoíēsis, per-ee-poy'-ay-sis; from G4046; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension,
 preservation:—obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

G4048.definition:
περιῤῥήγνυμι perirrhḗgnymi, per-ir-hrayg'-noo-mee; from G4012 and G4486; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:—rend
 off.

G4049.definition:
περισπάω perispáō, per-ee-spah'-o; from G4012 and G4685; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to
 distract (with care):—cumber.

G405.definition:
ἀνδραποδιστής andrapodistḗs, an-drap-od-is-tace'; from a derivative of a compound of G435 and G4228; an enslaver (as
 bringing men to his feet):—menstealer.

G4050.definition:
περισσεία perisseía, per-is-si'-ah; from G4052; surplusage, i.e. superabundance:—abundance(-ant, (-ly)),
 superfluity.

G4051.definition:
περίσσευμα perísseuma, per-is'-syoo-mah; from G4052; a surplus, or superabundance:—abundance, that was left,
 over and above.

G4052.definition:
περισσεύω perisseúō, per-is-syoo'-o; from G4053; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be
 superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or
 excel:—(make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more)
 abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase,
 be left, redound, remain (over and above).

G4053.definition:
περισσός perissós, per-is-sos'; from G4012 (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or
 superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with
 G1537) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:—exceeding abundantly
 above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond
 measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

G4055.definition:
περισσότερος perissóteros, per-is-sot'-er-os; comparative of G4053; more superabundant (in number, degree or
 character):—more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

G4056.definition:
περισσοτέρως perissotérōs, per-is-sot-er'-oce; adverb from G4055; more superabundantly:—more abundant(-ly),
 × the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much
 more, the rather.

G4057.definition:
†περισσῶς perissōs, per-is-soce'; adverb from G4053; superabundantly:—exceedingly, out of measure, the
 more.

G4058.definition: περιστερά peristerá, per-is-ter-ah'; of uncertain derivation; a pigeon:—dove, pigeon.

G4059.definition:
περιτέμνω peritémnō, per-ee-tem'-no; from G4012 and the base of G5114; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to
 circumcise:—circumcise.

G406.definition: Ἀνδρέας Andréas, an-dreh'-as; from G435; manly; Andreas, an Israelite:—Andrew.

G4060.definition:
περιτίθημι peritíthēmi, per-ee-tith'-ay-mee; from G4012 and G5087; to place around; by implication, to
 present:—bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set
 about.

G4061.definition:
περιτομή peritomḗ, per-it-om-ay'; from G4059; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people,
 literally or figuratively):—X circumcised, circumcision.

G4062.definition:
περιτρέπω peritrépō, per-ee-trep'-o; from G4012 and the base of G5157; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to
 craze:—+ make mad.

G4063.definition:
περιτρέχω peritréchō, per-ee-trekh'-o; from G4012 and G5143 (including its alternate); to run around, i.e.
 traverse:—run through.

G4064.definition:
περιφέρω periphérō, per-ee-fer'-o; from G4012 and G5342; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and
 thither:—bear (carry) about.

G4065.definition:
περιφρονέω periphronéō, per-ee-fron-eh'-o; from G4012 and G5426; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate
 (contemn):—despise.

G4066.definition:
περίχωρος períchōros, per-ikh'-o-ros; from G4012 and G5561; around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun,
 with G1093 implied vicinity):—country (round) about, region (that
 lieth) round about.

G4067.definition:
†περίψωμα perípsōma, per-ip'-so-mah; from a comparative of G4012 and ψάω psáō (to rub); something brushed all
 around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):—offscouring.

G4068.definition:
περπερεύομαι perpereúomai, per-per-yoo'-om-ahee; middle voice from πέρπερος pérperos (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the
 base of G4008); to boast:—vaunt itself.

G4069.definition: Περσίς Persís, per-sece'; a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female:—Persis.

G407.definition: †ἀνδρίζομαι andrízomai, an-drid'-zom-ahee; middle voice from G435; to act manly:—quit like men.

G4070.definition:
πέρυσι pérysi, per'-oo-si; adverb from G4009; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:—+ a year
 ago.

G4071.definition:
πετεινόν peteinón, pet-i-non'; neuter of a derivative of G4072; a flying animal, i.e. bird:—bird,
 fowl.

G4072.definition: †πέτομαι pétomai, pet'-om-ahee; middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:—fly(-ing).

G4073.definition:
πέτρα pétra, pet'-ra; feminine of the same as G4074; a (mass of) rock (literally or
 figuratively):—rock.

G4074.definition:
Πέτρος Pétros, pet'-ros; apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than G3037); as a
 name, Petrus, an apostle:—Peter, rock. Compare G2786.

G4075.definition: πετρώδης petrṓdēs, pet-ro'-dace; from G4073 and G1491; rock-like, i.e. rocky:—stony.

G4076.definition: πήγανον pḗganon, pay'-gan-on; from G4078; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves):—rue.

G4077.definition:
πηγή pēgḗ, pay-gay'; probably from G4078 (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount
 (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood,
 enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring):—fountain, well.

G4078.definition:
πήγνυμι pḗgnymi, payg'-noo-mee; a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs
 only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e.
 (specially) to set up (a tent):—pitch.

G4079.definition:
πηδάλιον pēdálion, pay-dal'-ee-on; neuter of a (presumed) derivative of πηδόν pēdón (the blade of an oar; from
 the same as G3976); a "pedal", i.e. helm:—rudder.

G408.definition:
Ἀνδρόνικος Andrónikos, an-dron'-ee-kos; from G435 and G3534; man of victory; Andronicos, an
 Israelite:—Adronicus.

G4080.definition:
πηλίκος pēlíkos, pay-lee'-kos; a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of G4225; how much (as
 an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity:—how great
 (large).

G4081.definition: πηλός pēlós, pay-los'; perhaps a primary word; clay:—clay.

G4082.definition: πήρα pḗra, pay'-rah; of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:—scrip.

G4083.definition:
πῆχυς pēchys, pay'-khoos; of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a
 cubit:—cubit.

G4084.definition:
πιάζω piázō, pee-ad'-zo; probably another form of G971; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the
 hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting
 (capture)):—apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare G4085.

G4085.definition: πιέζω piézō, pee-ed'-zo; another form for G4084; to pack:—press down.

G4086.definition:
πιθανολογία pithanología, pith-an-ol-og-ee'-ah; from a compound of a derivative of G3982 and G3056; persuasive
 language:—enticing words.

G4087.definition: πικραίνω pikraínō, pik-rah'-ee-no; from G4089; to embitter (literally or figuratively):—be (make) bitter.

G4088.definition:
πικρία pikría, pik-ree'-ah; from G4089; acridity (especially poison), literally or
 figuratively:—bitterness.

G4089.definition:
πικρός pikrós, pik-ros'; perhaps from G4078 (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent),
 i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively):—bitter.

G409.definition: ἀνδροφόνος androphónos, an-drof-on'-os; from G435 and G5408; a murderer:—manslayer.

G4090.definition: πικρῶς pikrōs, pik-roce'; adverb from G4089; bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently:—bitterly.

G4091.definition: Πιλᾶτος Pilâtos, pil-at'-os; of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman:—Pilate.

G4092.definition:
πίμπρημι pímprēmi, pim'-pray-mee; a reduplicated and prolonged form of a
 primary πρέω préō preh'-o; which occurs only as an alternate in certain
 tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become
 inflamed with fever):—be (X should have) swollen.

G4093.definition: πινακίδιον pinakídion, pin-ak-id'-ee-on; diminutive of G4094; a tablet (for writing on):—writing table.

G4094.definition: πίναξ pínax, pin'-ax; apparently a form of G4109; a plate:—charger, platter.

G4095.definition:
πίνω pínō, pee'-no; a prolonged form of
    πίω píō  pee'-o; which (together with another form)
    πόω póō  po'-o; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; 

 to imbibe (literally or figuratively):—drink.

G4096.definition:
πιότης piótēs, pee-ot'-ace; from πίων píōn (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of G4095 through the idea
 of repletion);

 plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness
 (oiliness):—fatness.

G4097.definition:
πιπράσκω pipráskō, pip-ras'-ko; contracted from περάω peráō (to traverse; from the base of G4008); to traffic
 (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery
 (literally or figuratively):—sell.

G4098.definition:
†πίπτω píptō, pip'-to; probably akin to G4072 through the idea of alighting; to fall
 (literally or figuratively):—fail, fall (down), light on.

G4099.definition: Πισιδία Pisidía, pis-id-ee'-ah; probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:—Pisidia.

G41.definition: ἁγιότης hagiótēs, hag-ee-ot'-ace; from G40; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state):—holiness.

G410.definition:
ἀνέγκλητος anénklētos, an-eng'-klay-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1458; unaccused,
 i.e. (by implication) irreproachable:—blameless.

G4100.definition:
πιστεύω pisteúō, pist-yoo'-o; from G4102; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or
 thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's
 spiritual well-being to Christ):—believe(-r), commit (to trust), put
 in trust with.

G4101.definition: πιστικός pistikós, pis-tik-os'; from G4102; trustworthy, i.e. genuine (unadulterated):—spike-(nard).

G4102.definition:
πίστις pístis, pis'-tis; from G3982; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious
 truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially
 reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such
 profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth
 itself:—assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

G4103.definition:
πιστός pistós, pis-tos'; from G3982; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively,
 trustful:—believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

G4104.definition: πιστόω pistóō, pis-to'-o; from G4103; to assure:—assure of.

G4105.definition:
πλανάω planáō, plan-ah'-o; from G4106; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or
 virtue):—go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

G4107.definition:
πλανήτης planḗtēs, plan-ay'-tace; from G4108; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic
 teacher:—wandering.

G4108.definition:
πλάνος plános, plan'-os; of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an
 impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

G4109.definition:
πλάξ pláx, plax; from G4111; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet,
 literally or figuratively):—table.

G411.definition:
ἀνεκδιήγητος anekdiḗgētos, an-ek-dee-ay'-gay-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555; not
 expounded in full, i.e. indescribable:—unspeakable.

G4110.definition: πλάσμα plásma, plas'-mah; from G4111; something moulded:—thing formed.

G4111.definition: πλάσσω plássō, plas'-so; a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:—form.

G4112.definition:
πλαστός plastós, plas-tos'; from G4111; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively)
 fictitious (false):—feigned.

G4113.definition: πλατεῖα plateîa, plat-i'-ah; feminine of G4116; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square:—street.

G4114.definition: πλάτος plátos, plat'-os; from G4116; width:—breadth.

G4115.definition: πλατύνω platýnō, plat-oo'-no; from G4116; to widen (literally or figuratively):—make broad, enlarge.

G4116.definition: πλατύς platýs, plat-oos'; from G4111; spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. broad:—wide.

G4117.definition: πλέγμα plégma, pleg'-mah; from G4120; a plait (of hair):—broidered hair.

G4119.definition:
πλείων pleíōn, pli-own; comparative of G4183; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in
 plural) the major portion:—X above, + exceed, more excellent,
 further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more)
 part, + yet but.

G412.definition:
ἀνεκλάλητος aneklálētos, an-ek-lal'-ay-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583; not
 spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable:—unspeakable.

G4120.definition: πλέκω plékō, plek'-o; a primary word; to twine or braid:—plait.

G4121.definition:
πλεονάζω pleonázō, pleh-on-ad'-zo; from G4119; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or
 intransitively); by extension, to superabound:—abound, abundant, make
 to increase, have over.

G4122.definition:
πλεονεκτέω pleonektéō, pleh-on-cek-teh'-o; from G4123; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach:—get
 an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

G4123.definition:
πλεονέκτης pleonéktēs, pleh-on-ek'-tace; from G4119 and G2192; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain
 (avaricious, hence a defrauder):—covetous.

G4124.definition:
πλεονεξία pleonexía, pleh-on-ex-ee'-ah; from G4123; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency,
 extortion:—covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

G4125.definition: πλευρά pleurá, plyoo-rah'; of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:—side.

G4126.definition:
πλέω pléō, pleh'-o; probably a form of G4150 (through the idea of plunging through the
 water); to pass in a vessel:—sail. See also G4130.

G4127.definition:
πληγή plēgḗ, play-gay'; from G4141; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a
 calamity:—plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

G4128.definition:
πλῆθος plēthos, play'-thos; from G4130; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:—bundle,
 company, multitude.

G4129.definition:
πληθύνω plēthýnō, play-thoo'-no; from another form of G4128; to increase (transitively or
 intransitively):—abound, multiply.

G413.definition:
ἀνέκλειπτος anékleiptos, an-ek'-lipe-tos; from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587; not
 left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible:—that faileth not.

G4131.definition: πλήκτης plḗktēs, plake'-tace; from G4141; a smiter, i.e. pugnacious (quarrelsome):—striker.

G4132.definition: πλήμμυρα plḗmmyra, plame-moo'-rah; prolonged from G4130; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:—flood.

G4133.definition:
πλήν plḗn, plane; from G4119; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather,
 yet:—but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

G4134.definition: πλήρης plḗrēs, play'-race; from G4130; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete:—full.

G4135.definition:
πληροφορέω plērophoréō, play-rof-or-eh'-o; from G4134 and G5409; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely
 assure (or convince), entirely accomplish:—most surely believe, fully
 know (persuade), make full proof of.

G4136.definition: πληροφορία plērophoría, play-rof-or-ee'-ah; from G4135; entire confidence:—(full) assurance.

G4137.definition:
πληρόω plēróō, play-ro'-o; from G4134; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up
 (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse,
 influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task),
 verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.:—accomplish, × after,
 (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come),
 fully preach, perfect, supply.

G4138.definition:
πλήρωμα plḗrōma, play'-ro-mah; from G4137; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as
 contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what
 is filled (as container, performance, period):—which is put in to
 fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

G4139.definition:
πλησίον plēsíon, play-see'-on; neuter of a derivative of πέλας pélas (near); (adverbially) close by; as
 noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or
 friend):—near, neighbour.

G414.definition: †ἀνεκτότερος anektóteros, an-ek-tot'-er-os; comparative of a derivative of G430; more endurable:—more tolerable.

G4140.definition:
πλησμονή plēsmonḗ, place-mon-ay'; from a presumed derivative of G4130; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively)
 gratification:—satisfying.

G4142.definition:
πλοιάριον ploiárion, ploy-ar'-ee-on; neuter of a presumed derivative of G4143; a boat:—boat, little (small)
 ship.

G4143.definition: πλοῖον ploîon, ploy'-on; from G4126; a sailer, i.e. vessel:—ship(-ing).

G4144.definition: πλόος plóos, plo'-os; from G4126; a sail, i.e. navigation:—course, sailing, voyage.

G4145.definition: πλούσιος ploúsios, ploo'-see-os; from G4149; wealthy; figuratively, abounding with:—rich.

G4146.definition: πλουσίως plousíōs, ploo-see'-oce; adverb from G4145; copiously:—abundantly, richly.

G4147.definition:
πλουτέω ploutéō, ploo-teh'-o; from G4148; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively):—be
 increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

G4148.definition: πλουτίζω ploutízō, ploo-tid'-zo; from G4149; to make wealthy (figuratively):—en- (make) rich.

G4149.definition:
πλοῦτος ploûtos, ploo'-tos; from the base of G4130; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money,
 possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially),
 valuable bestowment:—riches.

G415.definition: ἀνελεήμων aneleḗmōn, an-eleh-ay'-mone; from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1655; merciless:—unmerciful.

G4150.definition:
πλύνω plýnō, ploo'-no; a prolonged form of an obsolete πλύω plýō (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e.
 launder clothing:—wash. Compare G3068, G3538.

G4151.definition:
πνεῦμα pneûma, pnyoo'-mah; from G4154; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by
 analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by
 implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or
 (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the
 Holy Spirit:—ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare G5590.

G4152.definition:
πνευματικός pneumatikós, pnyoo-mat-ik-os'; from G4151; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross),
 or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural,
 regenerate, religious:—spiritual. Compare G5591.

G4153.definition:
πνευματικῶς pneumatikōs, pnyoo-mat-ik-oce'; adverb from G4152; non-physically, i.e. divinely,
 figuratively:—spiritually.

G4154.definition: πνέω pnéō, pneh'-o; a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze:—blow. Compare G5594.

G4155.definition:
πνίγω pnígō, pnee'-go; strengthened from G4154; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to
 throttle or strangle (drown):—choke, take by the throat.

G4156.definition:
πνικτός pniktós, pnik-tos'; from G4155; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to
 death (not bled):—strangled.

G4157.definition: πνοή pnoḗ, pno-ay'; from G4154; respiration, a breeze:—breath, wind.

G4158.definition:
ποδήρης podḗrēs, pod-ay'-race; from G4228 and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (G2066
 implied) reaching the ankles:—garment down to the foot.

G4159.definition:
πόθεν póthen, poth'-en; from the base of G4213 with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as
 interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or
 cause:—whence.

G416.definition: ἀνεμίζω anemízō, an-em-id'-zo; from G417; to toss with the wind:—drive with the wind.

G4160.definition:
ποιέω poiéō, poy-eh'-o; apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in
 a very wide application, more or less direct):—abide, + agree,
 appoint, × avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth),
 cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any
 delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have,
